title: People Analytics & Rewards Specialist
employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
description:
As Impact Fund Denmark continues to grow and professionalise, we want more of our people and organisational decisions to be grounded in evidence, data and a clear understanding of what drives behaviour and performance.

That is why we are creating a new role at the intersection of People Analytics, Reward and Talent.

You might already work in HR and be looking to build deeper analytical expertise. Or you may come from organisational psychology, economics, analytics or a related field and want to apply your skills in a People & Culture setting.

Either way, what matters most is that you are curious about how organisations work, comfortable working with data, and able to turn analysis into useful insights and practical recommendations and that you take pride in contributing and getting things to impact.

You will report to our Head of People & Culture.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Your role is to help us understand our organisation better — and use that understanding to make better decisions.

Your work will span analytics, reward and talent. You will:

  • Analyse employee, performance, engagement, talent and compensation data

  • Turn data and research into clear conclusions and practical recommendations for People & Culture and management

  • Support compensation benchmarking and our annual salary and compensation processes

  • Contribute to the implementation of the EU Pay Transparency requirements, including the related analysis and reporting

  • Develop dashboards, recurring People reporting and metrics that help us focus on what matters

  • Analyse engagement survey results and help turn them into meaningful organisational actions

  • Support talent, succession and performance processes with analysis and insight

  • Bring relevant research from organisational psychology and behavioural science into the way we design and evaluate People initiatives

  • Challenge assumptions and help us understand whether our interventions are having the intended effect

  • Prepare clear presentations and decision material for colleagues and leadership

  • Contribute to selected organisational development and talent projects

YOUR FIRST YEAR

By the end of your first year, we would expect to see progress in five areas:

  • Data: our People reporting and analytics are clearer, more consistent and more useful

  • Reward: compensation processes are supported by reliable analysis and relevant market data

  • Listening: employee survey data is translated into meaningful insights rather than simply reported

  • Evidence: important People initiatives increasingly have a clear evidence base, purpose and intended outcome

  • Decision support: People & Culture and leadership receive concise, relevant analysis that helps them make better decisions

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

This is what we need to see:

  • A relevant academic background, for example in psychology, organisational psychology, economics, business, HR, statistics or another analytical discipline

  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills

  • A few years of relevant professional experience. We care more about the quality and relevance of your experience than an exact number of years

  • Strong Excel skills and confidence working with data

  • The ability to move from data or research to a clear conclusion and a practical recommendation

  • Intellectual curiosity and a genuine interest in understanding why People practices work — rather than simply following established practice

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Professional fluency in English

These would be advantages, but they are not requirements:

  • Previous HR experience

  • Experience with Compensation & Benefits or Reward

  • Experience with People Analytics, employee surveys or HR reporting

  • Knowledge of statistics or research methodology

  • Experience with Power BI or similar visualisation tools

  • Experience applying organisational psychology or behavioural science in an organisational setting

  • Emotional intelligence, active listening and the ability to stay neutral under pressure

  • Courage to address uncomfortable issues, strong mediation and conflict-resolution capability

  • Professional fluency in Danish

WHERE THE ROLE SITS

This is an individual-contributor role within People & Culture.

You will work closely with the Head of People & Culture and with colleagues responsible for People Partnering, Operations and Recruitment.

Your role is to bring analytical depth and an evidence-based perspective to the areas where it can improve our decisions — particularly Reward, Talent, engagement and organisational development.

The scope is intentionally broad enough for you to grow and develop, but the professional core is clear: using data and evidence to improve people and organisational decisions.

WHY JOIN US

This is an opportunity to:

  • Help build a new capability at the intersection of People Analytics, Reward and Talent

  • Work closely with the Head of People & Culture and colleagues across the function

  • Apply data, research and behavioural science to real organisational questions

  • Build broad experience across compensation, talent, engagement and organisational development

  • Work in an organisation where the People agenda connects to a wider purpose: our colleagues support investments in green energy and infrastructure, financial services, sustainable food systems and healthcare in developing countries

GMT trades in used machinery for the rebar industry and is a well-known player in the industry across most of the world.

As a workshop mechanic, you will be responsible for keeping the workshop running and the machines in good order. Your tasks will include:

-Repair and preparation of used machines for the rebar industry
-Loading and unloading machines and accessories using a forklift truck (a valid forklift/truck licence is required)
-General maintenance and tidiness in the workshop

The workshop has an office attached to it, so you will have good colleagues around you, and we have lunch together.

The workshop has modern facilities, including a laser cleaner for removing rust and dirt, and we place great emphasis on the work being carried out safely and properly.

In the workshop itself you will typically be the only mechanic on a daily basis, so you must be able to plan and carry out your tasks independently.

We expect you to

-Have a technical/trade background, e.g. as a car or truck mechanic, industrial electrician, or mechatronics technician, with good mechanical aptitude
-Have at least 10 years of relevant work experience
-Hold a valid forklift/truck licence
-Be responsible and have a can-do attitude
-Be able to work independently and organise your own working day
-Not be afraid of getting dirty
-Understand and speak English

title: Part-time Administrative Officer for the Centre for Industrial Mechanics
description:
The Faculty of Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a part-time Administrative Officer position at the Centre for Industrial Mechanics (CIM), part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the SDU Sønderborg campus.

We are looking for a structured and proactive colleague who can support the Centre’s day-to-day administration, assist with project coordination, and contribute to the planning and organization of conferences, workshops, meetings and other academic and industrial events. The position offers the opportunity to work in an international university environment with close interaction with academic staff, students, external partners and administrative units.

Unique opportunity

The Centre for Industrial Mechanics combines research, education and collaboration with industry across areas including mechanical engineering, energy systems, renewable energy, artificial intelligence, mechatronics and related technologies. As the Centre continues to develop its activities and external collaborations, effective administrative and project support is important for ensuring smooth daily operations and successful delivery of events and projects.

The successful candidate will become part of an international and collaborative working environment and will have a varied portfolio of tasks. The role is well suited to a person who enjoys organizing, coordinating and communicating, and who is comfortable handling both routine administrative duties and changing priorities.

Workplace description

The Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at SDU conducts research and education from fundamental engineering principles to applied solutions. The Centre for Industrial Mechanics is located in the Alsion building at SDU’s Sønderborg campus and benefits from strong connections with companies and organizations in Southern Denmark and Northern Germany. The working environment is international, and English is widely used in daily communication.

Duties of the position

  • Conference and Event Organization: Support the planning and practical organization of conferences, workshops, seminars, project meetings and other events. Tasks may include registration, participant communication, invitations, agendas, room coordination, catering, travel arrangements, accommodation, event materials and on-site support.

  • Daily Administrative Support: Assist with general administrative tasks for the Centre and its research groups, including correspondence, document preparation, meeting coordination, scheduling, filing, maintaining administrative records and following up on agreed actions.

  • Project Administration and Coordination: Support externally and internally funded projects with practical project-management tasks such as meeting planning, collection of inputs from partners, follow-up on deadlines and deliverables, preparation of simple status overviews, and coordination of project documentation.

  • Meeting Support: Organize internal and external meetings, prepare agendas and supporting material when required, take meeting notes or minutes, and assist with follow-up of decisions and action points.

  • Communication and Stakeholder Coordination: Communicate professionally with colleagues, students, project partners, companies, conference participants and other external stakeholders, and help ensure that relevant information is shared in a timely and structured manner.

  • Travel and Visit Coordination: Assist with practical arrangements for staff travel, guest visits, invited speakers and visiting researchers in accordance with SDU procedures.

  • Documentation and Information Management: Maintain structured project and administrative files, contact lists, event information, templates, presentations and other shared material, and support the collection and organization of information needed for reports and internal follow-up.

  • Financial and Procurement Support: Provide practical administrative assistance related to purchases, invoices, reimbursements, budgets and project expenses in coordination with the relevant SDU administrative functions. The role does not require responsibility for formal financial approval.

  • Other Administrative Tasks: Contribute flexibly to other administrative and organizational tasks that arise in the daily operation of the Centre and its projects.

We are seeking a reliable and motivated candidate with strong organizational and communication skills. The position does not require a specific advanced academic specialization; a relevant Bachelor’s or Master’s degree is sufficient.

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in business administration, management, communication, social sciences, humanities, engineering management, public administration, project management, or another relevant field.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage several tasks, deadlines and stakeholders in parallel.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • A structured, responsible and service-oriented approach to administrative work.

  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with academic and administrative colleagues.

  • Good general digital skills, including confidence using common office applications such as Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams.

  • Attention to detail and the ability to handle information and documentation systematically.

It will be considered an advantage if you have

  • Previous experience with administration, event or conference organization, project coordination, or similar support functions.

  • Experience from a university, research organization, public institution or an international working environment.

  • Experience supporting externally funded projects or collaboration with companies and other external partners.

Personal qualifications

We value a colleague who is approachable, dependable and solution-oriented. You should enjoy creating structure, helping others and following tasks through to completion. Since the role involves interaction with many different people, we also expect you to communicate clearly and professionally and to handle changing priorities with flexibility.

The position is part-time with anticipated 12 hours per week. It is time limited to 1 year with the possibility for extension.

The exact weekly working hours and distribution of working time will be agreed in connection with the appointment. 

The workplace is Campus Soenderborg. 

Preferred starting date: As soon as possible. 

Further information

For further information about the position, please contact Associate Professor Lars Duggen, Centre for Industrial Mechanics, University of Southern Denmark, e-mail: duggen@sdu.dk.

Information about the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering and the Centre for Industrial Mechanics is available on SDU’s website.

Application procedure

Applications must be submitted electronically through SDU’s recruitment system. The application should include the following:

  • A motivated application describing your interest in the position and relevant experience.

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Documentation of relevant Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree.

  • Any additional documentation that you consider relevant to the position.

Application deadline is September 24, 2026 at 23:59 o'clock.

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. 

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out. 

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

title: Senior Controller
description:
Senior Controller

Work tasks: As part of the global bioeconomy, Stora Enso is a leading provider of renewable products in the areas of packaging, biomaterials and wooden construction, as well as one of the world’s largest privately owned forest owners. We believe that everything that is produced today from materials based on fossil raw materials can be made from wood in the future.
Our company employs approximately 19,000 people. Our global Finance Operations unit handles accounting activities and provides financial services across a range of areas. In the world of finance, we value accuracy, collaboration and innovation. Career for a better climate. Every day. Your Responsibilities as a Senior Controller Act as a Finance Business Partner for a business area/business unit, legal entity or group function. Lead or support controlling and financial reporting processes for the entity/function within your area of responsibility. Be responsible for the effective and accurate period-end closing, analysis and reporting activities of the entity/function. Contribute to and support the implementation and management of an efficient and accurate forecasting and budgeting process within the entity/function. Represent the entity/function in queries related to other Finance Operations processes, including Record to Report (RtR), Purchase to Pay (PtP) and Order to Cash (OtC). Ensure the implementation and compliance with Stora Enso’s financial processes and policies within the entity/function. Proactively identify opportunities for improvement, make recommendations and lead changes to continuously improve and harmonise end-to-end controlling processes. Lead and support process automation and other development projects. Ensure close collaboration and effective information flow between the entity/function, the Finance department and key stakeholders across other functions. Support and train stakeholders on controlling-related topics. What We Expect from You A Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field. At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in controlling, management reporting or accounting. A good understanding of controlling processes, including period-end closing, operational financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting and management reporting. Good knowledge of controlling tools and analytics platforms, such as Excel, SAP, OneStream and Power BI. Experience in leading process improvement and harmonisation initiatives. A change-oriented mindset – you are willing to improve processes, develop new ways of working and promote standardisation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a high level of attention to detail and quality. The ability to work in a matrix organisation and in an international environment. description:
Endiselt otsime sellist meest-naist, kes teab ka midagi autodest, praktikas, mitte teoorias.

Tööülesanded: Meil on töökojas tõstukid, tööriistad, õli, rooste, katkised autod ja aeg-ajalt ka klient, kes vannub, et “enne teie juurde tulekut oli kõik korras”.
Kui sa ei minesta rooste peale, ei hakka nutma kinnise poldi pärast ja tead, et “kliendi sõber juba vaatas” tähendab tavaliselt uut õudusfilmi kapoti all — siis räägime. Puudu on veel üks **autoremondi lukksepp**, kes ei hakka nutma, kui polt on kinni, käsi on must või kapoti alt vaatab vastu järjekordne “kodune remont”.

Omalt poolt pakume: Meie poolt:
🔥 normaalne palk — kui oskad, siis saad ka raha; 🔥 päris töö, mitte niisama kapoti silitamine; 🔥 seltskond, kus nalja saab ja lumehelbekesed sulavad kiiresti; 🔥 tööriided, lisasoodustused; 🔥 autod, mille kallal saad oma viha seaduslikult välja elada.

Muud nõuded: Ootame sind, kui:
✅ tead, et haamer ei ole alati vägivald — vahel on see diagnostikavahend; ✅ saad aru, et “klõbin ees vasakul” võib tähendada kõike alates kondist kuni täieliku katastroofini; ✅ ei arva, et piduritoru paikamine teibiga on loominguline lahendus; ✅ oskad autot remontida nii, et see pärast ka päriselt töötab; ✅ sul on töötahe suurem kui soov reede pärastlõunal kella vaadata.

description:
.

Work tasks: Main Duties
• Prepare and cook a wide range of restaurant products, including savory and sweet dishes, baked products, pastries, dough products, fillings, sauces, soups, salads, desserts, and meat and fish dishes, according to established recipes and standards. • Prepare, roll, stretch, layer, fill, and handle dough and ensure consistent taste, texture, portioning, appearance, and presentation of finished products. • Organize and coordinate daily kitchen production, monitor product availability and workflow, adjust production when necessary, and maintain quality while minimizing waste. • Prepare and maintain the customer display/service line, including baking semi-ready products, arranging products, and ensuring appropriate availability, replenishment, presentation, and cleanliness. • Organize, coordinate, supervise, and control the daily operations of the restaurant-bakery, including customer service, kitchen and production activities, cleaning, storage, inventory, and overall operational readiness. • Prepare and coordinate daily, weekly, and monthly operational plans, including staffing, production, inventory, cleaning, maintenance, and other recurring requirements. • Monitor stock, ingredients, expiration dates, deliveries, inventory, write-offs, storage, and waste, and assist with ordering and stocktaking. • Maintain and ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, cleaning, allergen management, occupational safety, equipment, and workplace requirements. • Guide, supervise, train, and support cooks and other assigned employees; provide instructions and feedback, assess their job performance, coordinate their work and priorities, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed by assigned employees. • Communicate and coordinate effectively with servers, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to support smooth kitchen and restaurant operations. • Participate in and coordinate employee recruitment, including reviewing CVs and applications, communicating with candidates, conducting interviews, assessing candidates against position requirements, and supporting the selection of suitable employees. • Prepare and coordinate employee schedules, breaks, replacements, and staff deployment, adjusting staffing according to workload, absences, and operational requirements. • Monitor customer service and assist service staff when operationally necessary, particularly during busy periods, breaks, staff shortages, or absences. • Complete and monitor required production, inventory, cleaning, temperature, write-off, operational, and other records, checklists, documents, and reports. • Manage and participate in recipe implementation, menu and product development, testing, new-product introduction, and continuous improvement. • Identify operational or employee-performance deficiencies, take appropriate corrective action within assigned authority, and report significant issues to the Manager. • Take all appropriate actions and provide support the Manager in implementing operational decisions, procedures, standards, schedules, and plans and provide accurate information regarding restaurant operations. • Where specifically authorized and assigned in writing by the Employer, assume designated operational and supervisory responsibilities during the Manager’s absence.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: • Previous experience in restaurant operations and staff supervision, including coordinating, guiding, and monitoring cooks, servers, cleaners, or other operational employees.
• Strong ability to organize daily operations, prioritize tasks, distribute work, monitor employee performance, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed. • Experience with staff scheduling, task allocation, production planning, inventory and stock control, ordering, receiving deliveries, stocktaking, write-offs, and waste control. • Strong customer-service and communication skills, including experience handling customer requests, complaints, order problems, and other service-related issues. • Good knowledge of food safety, hygiene, allergen management, cleanliness, occupational health and safety, and general restaurant operating requirements. • Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with employees, management, suppliers, contractors, technicians, and other service providers. • Good computer skills, including experience with POS and inventory systems, spreadsheets, email, scheduling, reporting, and basic business documentation. • Strong leadership, organizational, planning, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage several priorities simultaneously. • Responsible, reliable, proactive, detail-oriented, trustworthy, and able to remain professional and solution-oriented during busy or challenging situations.

description:
Full-time, primarily onsite position in Tallinn. We welcome applications from both strong junior and mid-level Systems Engineers. Starting date as soon as possible or by agreement.

Work tasks: The Systems Engineer will support the definition, coordination, integration, verification and delivery of Golbriak Space’s optical communication systems.
Main responsibilities: * Capture, analyse, define and maintain system and subsystem requirements * Translate product and mission objectives into clear technical requirements, actions and deliverables * Allocate requirements across subsystems and maintain traceability throughout the product-development lifecycle * Coordinate interfaces between mechanical, optical, electronic, software, thermal, manufacturing and testing activities * Identify technical dependencies, assumptions, constraints, conflicts and risks * Develop system-level verification and validation plans and define appropriate acceptance criteria * Support system integration, testing, troubleshooting and qualification activities * Review test results and verification evidence against defined requirements * Coordinate the resolution of technical issues involving multiple engineering disciplines * Track technical activities, dependencies, risks, decisions and milestones * Prepare and support technical and design reviews * Maintain requirements specifications, interface documentation, verification plans, technical reports and engineering decision records * Support configuration management and the controlled implementation of engineering changes * Collaborate closely with founders, engineering leads, technical teams, suppliers, partners and customers * Contribute to the improvement of systems-engineering processes, documentation and development workflows

We offer: * A central engineering role with direct impact on advanced optical communication systems
* Meaningful technical ownership across requirements management, system integration, verification and engineering coordination * The opportunity to work across mechanical, optical, electronic, software, manufacturing and testing disciplines * Close collaboration with an international and multidisciplinary engineering team * The opportunity to develop your expertise in systems engineering, optical communications, telecommunications and aerospace * The ability to contribute to technical decisions, engineering processes and ways of working as the company grows * A gross monthly salary of €2100–€3000, depending on experience, skills and expected level of responsibility * Relocation support to Estonia if required * Reasonable flexibility in working hours, consistent with operational and team needs

Other requirements: We are looking for a candidate with strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, technical curiosity and the ability to understand complex systems as a whole. The person should be able to identify dependencies, constraints and potential conflicts between different engineering disciplines.
The successful candidate will be organised, reliable and willing to take ownership. They should be able to coordinate multiple technical activities and priorities simultaneously. Strong communication and collaboration skills are required, together with the ability to explain complex technical information clearly. The company’s working language is English, so professional working proficiency in English is required. The candidate must be willing to work primarily onsite in Tallinn and be comfortable in a fast-moving environment where priorities and technical requirements may evolve.

Lisaks vastutad kaupade väljapaneku ja riiulite täitmise ning kaupluse korrashoiu eest. Meeskonnana töötame ühtse eesmärgi nimel, mistõttu võib töö paindlikult hõlmata ka muid kaupluse igapäevaseid ülesandeid, näiteks kassas töötamist, laotööd ja klientide teenindamist infopunktis.

Pidevalt arenev töökeskkond – Edasiminek on meie jaoks oluline. Kui leiame midagi, mida saab paremini teha, astume järgmise sammu. Uuenemine ja arenemine on meie tegevuse oluline osa ning kajastub ka meie väärtustes. Võimalus ennast arendada – Töötajate areng on meie jaoks väga tähtis! Erilist tähelepanu pöörame juhtimise arendamisele ning koolitame ja toetame oma juhte erinevate juhtimis- ja arenguprogrammide kaudu. Abivalmis ja professionaalne meeskond – Meil ei jäeta kedagi üksi. Usume, et koos tegutsedes saavutame parima tulemuse. Meil on suurepärane meeskond – kuigi loomulikult oleme ka meie kõik lihtsalt inimesed. Tasakaal töö ja vaba aja vahel – Pärast tööpäeva võib ja peabki töö mõtetest välja lülitama!

Muud nõuded: Uues kolleegis hindame: meie väärtustega sobivat klienditeeninduslikku suhtumist. Varasemat kogemust kassas ja kaupluses töötamisel. title: Server
description:
Work tasks: Main areas of work:
- Welcome guests warmly, assist with seating arrangements, and provide exceptional service by answering inquiries and offering menu recommendations for food and beverages. - Prepare and serve food, and hot and cold drinks to established standards, ensuring quality and consistency. - Organize workstations, operate tools and appliances in the serving and work area, and notify the kitchen of low stock levels as needed. - Maintain cleanliness and sanitation in serving and work areas, tools, and equipment; adhere to food safety laws and hygiene protocols - Operate the POS system to process cash, card, and digital payments accurately, providing receipts and resolving customer payment inquiries professionally. - Ensure cleanliness and hygiene by washing dishes, clearing tables, and maintaining dining areas, inspecting and monitoring products to ensure freshness and presentation consistency in accordance with company procedures. - Adhere to food safety, hygiene, and workplace safety protocols, including proper food handling, storage, and waste disposal. - Collaborate with team members, manage multiple tasks efficiently, especially during peak service times to ensure smooth operations, and assist with replenishing stock and supplies. - Provide support during staff absences or high-demand periods, performing duties as assigned to meet business needs. - Perform tasks assigned by the Manager adhering to schedules and deadlines. - Follow company regulations, procedures, and technical guidelines, participate in quality control checks, report issues promptly, and provide updates or reports as required.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: - Friendly, professional, and customer-oriented with strong communication skills to provide exceptional service and create a welcoming atmosphere.
- Detail-oriented and proactive, and flexible ensuring accuracy in orders, presentation standards, and anticipating customer needs. - Demonstrates integrity, and punctuality, a reliable team player with strong problem-solving skills, capable of working independently and collaboratively to ensure smooth operations. - Health-conscious and committed to upholding food safety, hygiene, and workplace safety protocols. - Proficiency in coffee preparation (espresso machines) and knowledge of basic alcoholic drink recipes and responsible service practices (preferred). - Experience in operating POS systems, handling payments, and managing accurate transactions efficiently (preferred). - A valid health certificate is required for food handling. - Physical stamina to stand, walk, and carry trays or supplies for extended periods. - Legal eligibility to meet age requirements for serving alcohol. - Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as required. Details about the schedules will be provided during the recruitment process.

Manage waste disposal, restocking of supplies, and organization of workspaces. - Conduct weekly deep cleaning of furniture, fixtures, and high-use areas. - Maintain cleanliness and organization in storage rooms and employee spaces. - Assist cooks with basic food preparation tasks, such as washing, peeling, chopping, and portioning ingredients. - Prepare simple dishes, starters, salads, desserts, and beverages under supervision. - Clean and maintain kitchen equipment, utensils, and workstations, ensuring a hygienic working environment. - Assist in inventory management by receiving, inspecting, storing food deliveries properly, reviewing stock levels, checking expiration dates, and notifying supervisors of shortages. - title: Senior Cook
description:
Work tasks: Main Duties
• Prepare and cook a wide range of restaurant products, including savory and sweet dishes, baked products, pastries, dough products, fillings, sauces, soups, salads, desserts, and meat and fish dishes, according to established recipes and standards. • Prepare, roll, stretch, layer, fill, and handle dough and ensure consistent taste, texture, portioning, appearance, and presentation of finished products. • Organize and coordinate daily kitchen production, monitor product availability and workflow, adjust production when necessary, and maintain quality while minimizing waste. • Prepare and maintain the customer display/service line, including baking semi-ready products, arranging products, and ensuring appropriate availability, replenishment, presentation, and cleanliness. • Organize, coordinate, supervise, and control the daily operations of the restaurant-bakery, including customer service, kitchen and production activities, cleaning, storage, inventory, and overall operational readiness. • Prepare and coordinate daily, weekly, and monthly operational plans, including staffing, production, inventory, cleaning, maintenance, and other recurring requirements. • Monitor stock, ingredients, expiration dates, deliveries, inventory, write-offs, storage, and waste, and assist with ordering and stocktaking. • Maintain and ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, cleaning, allergen management, occupational safety, equipment, and workplace requirements. • Guide, supervise, train, and support cooks and other assigned employees; provide instructions and feedback, assess their job performance, coordinate their work and priorities, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed by assigned employees. • Communicate and coordinate effectively with servers, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to support smooth kitchen and restaurant operations. • Participate in and coordinate employee recruitment, including reviewing CVs and applications, communicating with candidates, conducting interviews, assessing candidates against position requirements, and supporting the selection of suitable employees. • Prepare and coordinate employee schedules, breaks, replacements, and staff deployment, adjusting staffing according to workload, absences, and operational requirements. • Monitor customer service and assist service staff when operationally necessary, particularly during busy periods, breaks, staff shortages, or absences. • Complete and monitor required production, inventory, cleaning, temperature, write-off, operational, and other records, checklists, documents, and reports. • Manage and participate in recipe implementation, menu and product development, testing, new-product introduction, and continuous improvement. • Identify operational or employee-performance deficiencies, take appropriate corrective action within assigned authority, and report significant issues to the Manager. • Take all appropriate actions and provide support the Manager in implementing operational decisions, procedures, standards, schedules, and plans and provide accurate information regarding restaurant operations. • Where specifically authorized and assigned in writing by the Employer, assume designated operational and supervisory responsibilities during the Manager’s absence.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: • Professional culinary education or vocational training in cooking, baking, pastry, catering, or a related field is preferred; equivalent substantial professional experience may also be considered.
• Strong practical culinary skills, including food preparation, cooking, baking, confectionary, dough preparation and handling, portioning, and product presentation. • Experience with layered or filled dough products, pastries, or similar baked products is highly desirable. • Ability to organize and coordinate daily kitchen production, prioritize tasks, manage high-volume periods, and maintain consistent product quality and availability. • Previous experience guiding or supervising kitchen staff and coordinating work with service staff. • Good knowledge of food safety, hygiene, allergen management, cleaning, storage, and occupational safety requirements. • Experience with inventory, stock control, ordering, deliveries, stock rotation, write-offs, and waste control. • Comfortable using POS, inventory systems, spreadsheets, email, and basic kitchen/production management software. • Strong attention to detail, organization, leadership, communication, problem-solving, and ability to work effectively under pressure. • Responsible, reliable, proactive, trustworthy, and committed to quality, cleanliness, teamwork, and customer satisfaction.

description:
Tööülesanded: Kas soovid teha tööd, millel on reaalne ja puhas mõju keskkonnale? Liitu meeskonnaga!
𝗔𝗦 𝗛𝗔𝗟𝗝𝗔𝗟𝗔 𝗦𝗢𝗢𝗝𝗨𝗦 otsib oma meeskonda kohusetundlikku ja tehnilise taibuga 𝗿𝗲𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗲𝗽𝘂𝗵𝗮𝘀𝘁𝗶𝘁𝗲 𝗼𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗮𝘁𝗼𝗿𝗶𝘁, kelle peamiseks ülesandeks on tagada puhastusprotsesside tõrgeteta ja efektiivne toimimine. 𝗣𝗲𝗮𝗺𝗶𝘀𝗲𝗱 𝘁𝗼̈𝗼̈𝘂̈𝗹𝗲𝘀𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗱: • 𝗦𝗲𝗮𝗱𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗲 𝗷𝘂𝗵𝘁𝗶𝗺𝗶𝗻𝗲: Reoveepuhasti seadmete ja tehnoloogiliste protsesside igapäevane jälgimine ning reguleerimine 𝗛𝗮𝗹𝗷𝗮𝗹𝗮 𝘃𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗮 territooriumil. • 𝗛𝗼𝗼𝗹𝗱𝘂𝘀 𝗷𝗮 𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗼𝗻𝘁: Puhasti seadmete (pumbad, mikserid, filtrid jne) hooldustööde teostamine ja jooksvate rikete kõrvaldamine. • 𝗞𝘃𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗲𝗲𝗱𝗶 𝗸𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗹: Proovide võtmine, lihtsamate analüüside tegemine ja tulemuste dokumenteerimine. • 𝗛𝗲𝗮𝗸𝗼𝗿𝗱: Puhasti territooriumi ja hoonete puhtuse ning korra tagamine. • 𝗩𝗮𝗹𝗺𝗶𝘀𝗼𝗹𝗲𝗸 𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗺𝗶𝘀𝗲𝗸𝘀: Osalemine valverütmis (vajadusel väljakutsetele reageerimine väljaspool tavapärast tööaega).

Omalt poolt pakume: • 𝗦𝘁𝗮𝗯𝗶𝗶𝗹𝘀𝘂𝘀𝘁: Kindlat ja pikaajalist tööd elutähtsas valdkonnas.
• 𝗩𝗮̈𝗹𝗷𝗮𝗼̃𝗽𝗲𝘁: Põhjalikku kohapealset juhendamist ja erialaseid täiendkoolitusi. • 𝗧𝗼̈𝗼̈𝘃𝗮𝗵𝗲𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗶𝗱: Kaasaegseid tööriistu ja isikukaitsevahendeid. • 𝗧𝗼𝗲𝘁𝘂𝘀𝘁: Sõbralikku ja toetavat meeskonda. • 𝗧𝗼̈𝗼̈𝘁𝗮𝘀𝘂: Konkurentsivõimelist palka.

Muud nõuded: 𝗢𝗼𝘁𝘂𝘀𝗲𝗱 𝗸𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗱𝗮𝗮𝗱𝗶𝗹𝗲:
• 𝗧𝗲𝗵𝗻𝗶𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲 𝘁𝗮𝗶𝗽: Huvi tehnika, mehaanika või automaatika vastu (suureks eeliseks on eelnev töökogemus tootmises, lukksepana või operaatorina). • 𝗔𝗿𝘃𝘂𝘁𝗶𝗼𝘀𝗸𝘂𝘀: Tavapärane arvutikasutuse oskus seadmete infosüsteemide (SCADA) jälgimiseks. • 𝗜𝘀𝗶𝗸𝘂𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗱𝘂𝘀𝗲𝗱: Kohusetunne, täpsus, iseseisvus ja hea füüsiline vorm. • 𝗝𝘂𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗼𝗮𝗱: B-kategooria juhilubade olemasolu. • 𝗞𝗲𝗲𝗹𝗲𝗼𝘀𝗸𝘂𝘀: Hea eesti keele oskus kõnes ja kirjas.

title: Senior Controller
description:
Senior Controller

Work tasks: As part of the global bioeconomy, Stora Enso is a leading provider of renewable products in the areas of packaging, biomaterials and wooden construction, as well as one of the world’s largest privately owned forest owners. We believe that everything that is produced today from materials based on fossil raw materials can be made from wood in the future.
Our company employs approximately 19,000 people. Our global Finance Operations unit handles accounting activities and provides financial services across a range of areas. In the world of finance, we value accuracy, collaboration and innovation. Career for a better climate. Every day. Your Responsibilities as a Senior Controller Act as a Finance Business Partner for a business area/business unit, legal entity or group function. Lead or support controlling and financial reporting processes for the entity/function within your area of responsibility. Be responsible for the effective and accurate period-end closing, analysis and reporting activities of the entity/function. Contribute to and support the implementation and management of an efficient and accurate forecasting and budgeting process within the entity/function. Represent the entity/function in queries related to other Finance Operations processes, including Record to Report (RtR), Purchase to Pay (PtP) and Order to Cash (OtC). Ensure the implementation and compliance with Stora Enso’s financial processes and policies within the entity/function. Proactively identify opportunities for improvement, make recommendations and lead changes to continuously improve and harmonise end-to-end controlling processes. Lead and support process automation and other development projects. Ensure close collaboration and effective information flow between the entity/function, the Finance department and key stakeholders across other functions. Support and train stakeholders on controlling-related topics. What We Expect from You A Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field. At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in controlling, management reporting or accounting. A good understanding of controlling processes, including period-end closing, operational financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting and management reporting. Good knowledge of controlling tools and analytics platforms, such as Excel, SAP, OneStream and Power BI. Experience in leading process improvement and harmonisation initiatives. A change-oriented mindset – you are willing to improve processes, develop new ways of working and promote standardisation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a high level of attention to detail and quality. The ability to work in a matrix organisation and in an international environment. Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence others and explain complex financial information to people who are not finance specialists. Very good command of English, both spoken and written.

We offer: By joining us, you will become part of an organisation with a diverse and inclusive work culture that supports you in discovering new perspectives and developing professionally.
You will contribute to a more sustainable world, as we believe that everything that is produced today from materials based on fossil raw materials can be made from wood in the future. To help you perform your work safely and feel well, we support both your physical and mental wellbeing. This is a permanent position with an open-ended employment contract. How to Apply You can submit your application to us only in English, using our recruitment system. We hope to receive your application as soon as possible, but no later than 24 September. If you have any questions, please contact our People and Culture representative, Alena Stesnerova, at alena.stesnerova[at]storaenso.com.

Option to work from home: Yes

title: Solution Architect
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Architect to help shape the future of banking technology. You will lead the architecture of domain-oriented data products and APIs that enable critical business capabilities across the bank. Working at the intersection of business, technology and data, you will partner with architects, engineers, product managers and senior stakeholders to create scalable, secure and resilient solutions. You will provide end-to-end architectural leadership across multiple delivery streams, while enabling teams to make effective decisions within clear architectural guardrails.

Your impact:
You will establish reusable data and API capabilities that accelerate delivery, improve interoperability and create value for customers and business partners.

What youll be doing:
 Lead architecture across domains
 Define and evolve the architecture vision, principles and roadmap for Data Products and Domain APIs.
 Align business capabilities, data assets, APIs and technology platforms across multiple delivery streams.
 Oversee the end-to-end solution architecture and coordinate the work of software architects embedded in individual delivery streams.
 Identify interfaces, data flows and cross-domain dependencies, and guide teams in evaluating solution alternatives.

Drive data product excellence:
 Establish patterns and standards for domain-owned data products that are discoverable, trustworthy, reusable and governed.
 Clarify data ownership, product boundaries, quality expectations, metadata, lineage and lifecycle responsibilities.
 Partner with business and technology stakeholders to maximise the value and safe use of data across the organisation.
 Promote modern data architecture practices, including data product thinking and domain ownership.

Shape the domain API landscape:
 Define API-first architecture principles, design standards, governance and lifecycle management practices.
 Guide the definition of domain boundaries, API contracts, versioning, security and reusable integration patterns.
 Ensure APIs are secure, scalable, resilient, observable and easy for consumers to use.
 Support event-driven and service-oriented integration approaches where they provide clear business and technology value.

Build resilient, delivery-ready solutions:
 Define solution-level functional requirements and non-functional requirements for availability, performance, security, scalability, resilience and operability.
 Define subsystems and interfaces, allocate responsibilities and clarify interactions with the wider solution context.
 Build and maintain the architectural runway needed for sustainable delivery and future change.
 Enable Continuous Delivery and DevOps through pragmatic design guidelines, automation and investment advocacy.

Collaborate and influence:
 Work closely with Product and Solution Management, business stakeholders, engineering teams, Enterprise Architects and external suppliers.
 Contribute architectural expertise to planning, high-level design, solution demonstrations and continuous exploration.
 Help shape and realise architectural enablers, including appropriate capacity allocation for enablement work.
 Communicate complex architecture decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
 Mentor architects and engineering teams, foster collaboration and enable decentralised decision-making.

Requirements:
 Experience and domain knowledge
 Significant experience in Solution Architecture, Domain Architecture, Enterprise Architecture or a comparable senior architecture role.
 A proven track record of designing and delivering enterprise-scale data, API and integration solutions.
 Experience leading architecture across multiple teams, products or technology domains.
 A strong understanding of banking technology and business processes. 
 Experience with Core Banking platforms is highly desirable.
 Experience working in complex, regulated environments with demanding security, resilience and data governance requirements.

description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior T24 Architect to shape the evolution of a large and complex Core Banking environment. You will define and guide the architecture of the Temenos T24 landscape, making sure that business capabilities, technology platforms and long-term strategic goals stay aligned.

You will work with business stakeholders, engineers, architects and external partners across multiple markets, providing architectural leadership over several initiatives and delivery streams. Your goal is to protect the stability and resilience of business-critical banking services while enabling platform modernisation and simplification.

Key Responsibilities:
 Shape and evolve the architecture roadmap for Temenos T24 and surrounding Core Banking capabilities, defining target-state architecture, principles and standards in line with business and technology strategy
 Provide end-to-end architectural leadership across complex initiatives, ensuring consistency, scalability and sustainability of the Core Banking landscape
 Translate business requirements into robust, implementable solutions, including integrations between Core Banking and payments, digital channels, lending, deposits, customer management and data platforms
 Identify interfaces, data flows and dependencies across applications, infrastructure and external services
 Evaluate architectural alternatives and make clear trade-offs between business value, delivery risk and technical complexity

 Define functional and non-functional requirements for availability, security, performance, scalability, resilience and operability
 Guide architecture reviews to ensure alignment with enterprise standards and regulatory expectations, and maintain the architectural runway for sustainable delivery
 Assess architectural risks, technical debt and lifecycle concerns, and guide proportionate remediation
 Act as a trusted advisor for strategic Core Banking initiatives and technology investment decisions, communicating complex topics clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
 Mentor architects and engineers, fostering collaboration and accountable decision-making within teams

 Deep understanding of Core Banking processes, platform capabilities and integration dependencies

 Banking experience involving demanding availability, security, resilience and regulatory requirements

You will support the decommissioning of legacy applications across Markets domains and decouple a big warehouse, getting consumers to the right target applications. You will drive analysis activities from initiation to completion and help teams understand where data is used today and how it can be sourced from strategic platforms in the future.

What youll be doing:
- Drive end-to-end analysis activities related to changing source system.
- Identify and analyse consumers of legacy applications, databases and data products.
- Map data flows, interfaces, reports and downstream dependencies.
- Engage with IT stakeholders to understand current usage patterns.
- Create and maintain inventories of consumers, interfaces and dependencies.
- Support migration planning and decommissioning activities.
- Perform data impact assessments and gap analyses.
- Document findings and present recommendations

Who you are:
- We believe you are an analytical and structured professional who enjoys solving complex problems.
- You have the ability to navigate large application landscapes and can simplify complex information for a broad stakeholder audience.
- You are comfortable driving activities independently while also collaborating closely with multiple teams and stakeholders.

Your experience and background:

- Experience working with system migrations, application decommissioning or transformation programmes.
- Understanding of data flows, interfaces and system integrations.
- Ability to drive analysis work independently and manage multiple stakeholders.

title: Business Controller, Kesko-IT
description:
Would you like to help build the IT steering of the future together with Finlands leading trade sector operator? We are looking for an experienced Business Controller to join K-IT to build the future of IT financial steering, cost transparency and support for management decision-making.

Your role

As a Business Controller, you will act as K-ITs finance partner and help ensure that decision-making is based on high-quality data and a solid business understanding. You will take an active part in budgeting, forecasting and reporting processes and support IT managements decision-making as a member of the K-IT management team. You will work with a broad network of stakeholders across K-IT and the business divisions, fostering a shared understanding of IT service costs, cost allocations, and the business value generated through technology investments

Your key responsibilities include:
- Analysing and reporting on Kesko Group IT costs - Coordinating budgeting and forecasting processes - Acting as a sparring partner for business and IT management on financial matters - Developing reporting, forecasting and analytics processes and tools - Driving the development of IT cost transparency through a TBM-based cost management model
To succeed in this role, we believe that you

Are an experienced Business Controller with the ability to grasp both the details and the bigger picture. You can challenge constructively and bring insights to support decision-making, but you also have the patience and accuracy to handle the necessary routines to a high standard.

We are looking for:
- several years of experience in Controller/Business Controller roles - experience in IT controlling or in monitoring IT costs - an understanding of cost allocations, service pricing or IT cost transparency solutions (experience of TBM-type models is considered an advantage) - the ability to combine data, business understanding and impactful communication - excellent collaboration and interpersonal skills - a development-oriented and proactive approach to work
In addition, we value:
- Anaplan skills - advanced Excel and reporting skills - knowledge of ServiceNow and related tools will be an advantage - fluency in Finnish and English - experience of financial steering in large organizations - a track record of using GenAI to develop both individual ways of working and/or finance processes
Why join us?

We offer you the opportunity to work in a front-row seat in one of Finlands largest IT organizations. You will be able to influence significant development initiatives, build new operating models and make use of modern technologies and GenAI as part of financial management.

At Kesko are working in a hybrid workplace model where we combine office days and remote work to best suit both the role and the team. The role is based at our headquarters in Helsinki. We offer extensive employee benefits unique to the K group. These include, among others: Culture & sport benefit (ePassi), shopping benefits that apply in K-Group stores and staff shops, own occupational health care services and leisure time accident insurance. You are also entitled to a car benefit according to our company policy. Several of our partners and customers also offer discounts for their services (e.g. optician, accommodation, sports and wellness). Come join our professional team and start building your own kind of career in K group!

Interested?

The application period ends on 9.10.2026.For more information about the task, please contact your future supervisor Terhi Haajanen, VP, Business services & Controlling. The best way to reach her is by phone on October 6 and October 8 between 14:00 and 15:00 (+358 10 532 2582). Please submit your application via the apply -link. We'd love to hear your salary expectations as well.

The selected candidate will be subject to a credit check and drug testing in accordance with Kesko's recruitment and employment practices.

We at K Group value diversity and believe that different backgrounds and perspectives are key to success. We strive to create a work environment where everyone has the opportunity to grow. Equality, non-discrimination, and fairness are our core principles in recruitment, compensation, and career development.

title: Data Engineer
description:
We at Olvi Group are looking for a

**DATA ENGINEER**

to continue our journey towards Olvi Groups IT Vision. Data Engineer will be responsible for designing and building of Olvi Groups data assets. Data Engineer will collaborate with several colleagues in Olvi Groups IT Center of Excellence organization.

**Your key responsibilities** will be

- Design and maintain scalable and secure data infrastructure and pipelines in our Cloud data warehouse according to defined best practices

- Integrate data from diverse sources, ensuring unified datasets for analysis

- Collaborate with Olvi Group IT Center of Excellence and business stakeholders to optimize workflows for analytics and AI

- Ensure data quality, consistency and availability for reporting and other business needs through effective modelling and integration

- Participate in Olvi Group development projects


We value previous experience as a Data Engineer or similar role (5+ years) and general experience of working in development projects as well as suitable education (Bachelor or Masters degree in Computer Science). Experience with AWS, PostgreSQL and SQL databases are required. Knowledge of Oracle DB and DevOps practices, GitHub/Gitea, Docker, IaaC is an asset. Previous experience of working in manufacturing industry is preferred. The ideal candidate has strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate with colleagues across different countries. You have fluent written and spoken English language skills.

**We offer** you a great opportunity to take this next step in your career, work across countries and functions in Olvi Group and experience opportunities to grow and develop.

**As a Data Engineer you will report** to Olvi Group IT Lead, Data and Analytics and your location might be in Helsinki or Iisalmi with flexible remote working possibility.

title: Wilderness Guide
description:
**Are you looking for meaningful work in the magical nature of Lapland? Do you want to provide guests with unforgettable experiences away from commercial mass tourism?**

**Flow Lapland Experiences Oy** is a Rovaniemi-based experience and activity service company offering high-quality, authentic, and personalized small-group tours. In our operations, we focus on high safety standards, genuine interactions, and unique nature experiences. We are now looking for a motivated and customer-oriented **Wilderness & Nature Guide**to join our team and create unforgettable moments for our international guests.

Your Versatile Responsibilities

As a guide, you will be the most important link between the customer and Laplands unique nature. Your workday will mainly consist of the following tasks:

- **Northern Lights Tours (Aurora Hunting):** Guiding groups and taking photography of the Northern Lights during evening and nighttime hours.

- **Winter Activities & Day Trips:** Leading diverse nature excursions, such as trips to the iconic Korouoma ice falls area and wildlife park visits.

- **Customer Service:** A warm, active, and attentive approach when interacting with guests from all over the world.

- **Responsibility & Safety:** Ensuring group safety, overall well-being, and tour schedules in arctic conditions.


What We Expect From You

**Requirements:**

- **Language Skills:** Excellent spoken English.

- **Driver's License:** A valid Category B driver's license and strong confidence driving in challenging arctic winter conditions.

- **Attitude:** A positive customer service mindset, flexibility, and strong teamwork skills.

- **Stress Tolerance:** Ability to act responsibly, calmly, and methodically, even in changing situations.


**Considered an Advantage:**

- Previous experience as a wilderness, nature, or activity guide.

- Valid first aid certification (e.g., EA1 / EA2 / Wilderness First Aid).

- Excellent photography skills (especially knowledge of Northern Lights and night photography).

- Proficiency in languages other than English.


What We Offer You

- **An Inspiring Work Community:** We are a close-knit and supportive team where we invest in everyones well-being through friendly competitions, social evenings, and team recreation days.

- **An Eventful Everyday Life:** A diverse and meaningful role in stunning surroundings—you get to experience Lapland's winter, snow-laden forests, and Northern Lights from the best seat in the house.

- **Training & Career Growth:** As a fresh and growing company, we aim to be an exemplary employer in the tourism industry. We offer comprehensive onboarding and genuine opportunities to develop and advance in your career.

- **Flat Hierarchy & Influence:** Our management is involved in daily operations, offering you the opportunity to significantly influence company development, participate in product development, and take on new responsibilities.

- **Remuneration:** We follow the collective agreement for the ski, tourism, restaurant, and leisure service sector (MaRaVa TES). Salary is determined according to the collective agreement or negotiable based on your experience.

title: Senior Fullstack Developer, remote work
description:
About the role

As a Senior Fullstack Developer, you will lead the modernization of our client's ERP system, transitioning legacy Java/GWT interfaces into modern React applications. Operating in a tight-knit, two-person team, you will leverage advanced agent-driven development tools.

You are offered
the opportunity to work 100% remotely on a long-term, stable project. You will have the creative freedom to pioneer agent-based AI development workflows and play a key role in modernizing a business-critical system.

Work tasks

Modernizing a legacy ERP system by transitioning it to a React and Java-based architecture, utilizing agent-based development methods to implement views, design APIs, and build supporting developer tools.
- Build and modernize ERP views, including search interfaces, editors, and dialogs using React
- Design and implement robust REST APIs to support the new frontend architecture
- Refactor legacy Java/GWT user interfaces into a modern React-based application
- Develop tools and validation checks to keep agent-driven development processes on track

We are looking for

- Advanced knowledge of TypeScript and React
- Practical experience working daily with agentic development methods like Claude Code
- Proven ability to read, refactor, and navigate large legacy codebases
- Strong eye for UI/UX design with the ability to identify and fix visual inconsistencies
- Professional proficiency in English

It is meritorious if you have
- Good knowledge of Java and REST APIs
- Experience with Geographic Information Systems (GIS) or spatial data analysis
- Experience with cloud services, specifically AWS
- Professional proficiency in Finnish
- Experience building business-critical ERP systems

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Kassatarjoilijana osallistut salin työtehtäviin mihin sisältyy esimerkiksi kahvilanhoitoa, kassatyöskentelyä, laskutusta, ruokalinjastojen täyttämistä, loppusiivoustyötä sekä asiakaspalvelua. Lisäksi tehtäviin kuuluu edustustarjoilun hoitamista, keskittyen iltapäivään ja alkuiltaan tilausten mukaisesti.

Näillä ominaisuuksilla pärjäät tehtävässä

Odotamme alan ammattitutkintoa sekä työkokemusta vastaavasta työstä. Toivomme hakijalta joustavuutta, oma-aloitteisuutta ja että olet iloinen asiakaspalvelija. Asiakkaiden kanssa jutustelu on sinulle luontaista ja haluat yllättää heidät joka kerta. Arvostamme erityisesti halua kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja kykyä mukautua muuttuviin tilanteisiin.

Työssäsi tarvitset hygieniapassin, anniskelupassin sekä suomen kielen taidon, englannin kielen taito katsotaan eduksi.

title: HSE Advisor
description:
Enersense Engineering is currently looking for a HSE Advisor to join our clients data centre project in Helsinki, Finland. In this role, you will support the Project Management and Site Health & Safety teams in ensuring a safe, compliant and well-managed project environment. The work will start as soon as possible.

Main tasks and responsibilities:
* Ensuring compliance with applicable Health & Safety and environmental legislation, project requirements and HSE management systems
* Reviewing and supporting the preparation of method statements, risk assessments, safe work plans and permit-to-work documentation
* Monitoring compliance with the project execution plan and ensuring that good safety practices are consistently maintained on site
* Conducting regular site inspections and HSE audits, documenting findings and following up on corrective actions
* Ensuring safety observations and interventions are properly recorded and followed through
* Coordinating ongoing assessments and controls related to hazardous substances and other workplace risks
* Maintaining records of statutory inspections for equipment, tools and plant used on the project
* Supporting accident and incident investigations and ensuring that findings are communicated to the relevant project stakeholders
* Monitoring subcontractor compliance with project and company HSE policies, procedures and requirements
* Supporting the coordination and maintenance of site inductions, HSE training and toolbox talks
* Participating in daily activity briefings and site coordination meetings
* Supporting waste reduction, recycling and other environmental initiatives in line with project requirements
* Taking a proactive approach to identifying HSE risks and supporting continuous improvement across the project

Requirements:
* Relevant higher education qualification in Health & Safety, Environmental Management or a related field
* NEBOSH Certificate or equivalent Health & Safety qualification is considered an advantage
* Good knowledge of applicable Health & Safety and environmental legislation, regulations and industry best practices
* Minimum 3 years of experience in similar role within large-scale construction, industrial or infrastructure projects
* Experience in preparing, reviewing and implementing HSE documentation, including method statements, risk assessments, permit-to-work systems and hazardous substance assessments
* Experience with accident and incident investigations and related reporting
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to promote a positive safety culture across a diverse project team
* English language skills

We follow pay transparency principles and the salary level and the criteria used to determine it will be communicated to candidates before the interview.

Due to GDPR regulations, applications will only be accepted through our official application system.

We manage this recruitment process internally and therefore do not require support from external recruitment agencies.

If you have any questions, please contact: Sanna Uronen, HR Coordinator, +358 40 176 5270, sanna.uronen@enersense.com

About us:

We are Enersenses Expert Services team. We deliver qualified and compliant workforce solutions for our clients' demanding technical and engineering projects locally and internationally. Our recruitment teams experts have for a long time been contributing to the success of our customers and Enersense. We have helped our clients to employ over 3000 specialists in various projects across 40 countries globally.

title: HSE Manager
description:

The work will start as soon as possible.

Main tasks and responsibilities:
* Ensure that project activities are carried out in accordance with the established HSE management system and project-specific requirements
* Develop, implement and maintain Construction Stage Health & Safety Plans throughout the project lifecycle
* Provide regular updates to senior management on HSE performance, key initiatives, risks and areas for improvement
* Ensure full compliance with applicable Health & Safety and environmental legislation, regulations and statutory requirements
* Implement and maintain project-specific Environmental, Health & Safety plans and procedures
* Review and support the preparation of method statements, risk assessments, Safe Plans of Action (SPA) and permit-to-work documentation
* Monitor implementation of the Project Execution Plan and ensure that relevant HSE requirements are followed

title: Etsitään kokenutta hitsaajaa
description:
**Etsitään asiakkaallemme Jamenet Oy:lle kokenutta hitsaajaa!**

Jamenet Oy on vakavarainen jo 40 vuotta alalla toiminut yritys. Laitekantaan panostetaan oikeasti – taloon on valmistunut ja hankittu viime aikoina 5 uutta konetta. Nyt etsimme tiimiin uutta rautaista ammattilaista!

- **Monipuolisuus:** Katsomme suureksi eduksi koneistusosaamisen sekä valmiuden asennus- ja muihin konepajahommiin.

- **Asenne ja ilmapiiri:** Olet itseohjautuva ja rehti tekijä, jolta löytyy sopivassa suhteessa rentoa asennetta ja huumorintajua arjen tekemiseen.

- **Joustavan päivätyön:** Mahdollisuuden sovittaa työaikoja.
