title: Depositary Services Senior Representative - Alternative Funds (Fixed-term) (m/f)
description:
At BBH, Partnership is more than a form of ownership-it's our approach to business and relationships.  We know that supporting your professional and personal goals is the best way to help our clients and advance our business. We take that responsibility seriously. With a 200-year legacy and a shared passion for what's next, this is the right place to build a fulfilling career.

Depositary Services Senior Representative - Alternative Funds (Fixed-term)

BBH is currently recruiting a Depositary Services Senior Representative to join our dynamic Depositary Services team. In this key role you will be responsible for the coordination and performance of tasks relating to the supervision of assets of Real Estate, Private Debt and Private Equity funds. In addition, you will assess, analyze, and monitor risks and control issues for the products and services falling under the scope of the Depositary obligations.  You will have a high level of technical acumen and analytical skills in order to foster a solution orientated and consultative approach to performing our Depositary obligations

Key Responsibilities:

• Gather and review documentation received in relation to recordkeeping and verification of ownership of real assets (real estate, private debt, private equity, fund of funds) and proactively monitor the status and completion of those tasks and follow up to obtain required client documentation
• Build Strong relationships with Clients and have the knowledge and ability to explain the regulatory drivers behind these requirements
• Review and/or execute daily cash flow monitoring activities by gathering information and reviewing exceptions
• Support team in determining appropriate resolutions to new regulatory obligations.
• Monitor, report, define and document critical internal control processes.
• Formulate corrective actions, where applicable, to resolve identified exceptions.
• Coordinate internal and external projects in an efficient and thorough manner.
• Prepare and review documentation for regulators and external auditors
• Support Team on questions from clients, regulators, external auditors and/or BBH internal departments. Communicate clearly with business area contacts as well as other areas of the Bank
• Maintain effective working relationships at relevant levels with other departments
• Escalate within the team significant audit issues, set direction/communicate proposed manner of resolution of audit issues and concerns that have a significant impact
• Develop and maintain peer relationships to share best practices

Qualifications:

1. Education level and/ or experience

• Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting
• 2 to 4 years' experience working within the alternative funds industry or relevant business line experience
• Proficient Business level German skills are considered as an advantage

2. Knowledge and skills

• Excellent analytical, communication and interpersonal skills with ability to present complex and sensitive issues
• Technical skills in alternatives and regulation
• Good knowledge in European and local regulatory requirements
• Demonstrates Microsoft Office skills (with emphasis placed on Excel proficiency).
• Ability to learn and adapt to new technologies and systems
• Ability to identify, escalate and resolve a problem.
• Ability to communicate professionally through effective verbal and written skills.
• Ability to manage time efficiently and effectively.
• Organizational skills and detail-oriented.
• Ability to work in a team environment.
• Ability to meet deadlines and work under pressure.
• Ability to manage and inspire people

We value diverse experiences. We value diverse experiences and transferrable skillsets. If your career hasn't followed a traditional path, includes alternative experiences, or doesn't meet every qualification or skill listed in the job description, please do go ahead and apply.

About BBH:

Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH) is a premier global financial services firm, known for premium service, specialist expertise, technology solutions and partnership approach to client management. Across Investor Services and Capital Partners, we work with an enviable roster of sophisticated clients who make BBH their first call when they are tackling their hardest challenges. Delivering for our clients and each other energizes us.

We believe that how we do our work is just as important as what we do. We are relentless problem solvers who know our best ideas come from collective debate and development-so we are never possessive about our ideas. Every day we come together as a diverse community of smart and caring people to deliver exceptional service and expert advice-creating success that lasts. No matter where you sit in the organization, everyone is empowered to contribute their ideas. BBHers can pick up the phone and call any colleague, and they are happy to help. Expanding your impact beyond your daily role is part of how we operate as trusted partners to one another.

We believe stability is a competitive advantage, but being stable means having the knowledge, skill, and discipline to evolve, often-pushing the boundaries of innovation.  As a private partnership, every investment we make is in the relationships, technologies, products and development we believe are in the long-term interests of our clients and our people. Our long-tenured leaders are experts in their areas and are actively involved in the day-to day business, taking the time to provide guidance and mentoring to build the next generation of BBHers. Because we know, our success begins with yours.

Go to BBH.com to learn more about our rewards and benefits, philanthropy, approach to sustainability or how we support you to thrive personally, physically and financially.

BGL BNP Paribas est une des plus grandes banques du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg et fait partie du Groupe BNP Paribas.

Senior Tax advisor (H/F)
  
CONTEXTE ET ENJEUX

Vous rejoindrez, en tant que « Senior Tax advisor », la Fonction des « Affaires fiscales » de BGL BNP Paribas.  

Vous participez ainsi activement à la réalisation des missions des Affaires Fiscales qui consistent notamment

• à assurer la maitrise du risque fiscal pour l'ensemble des opérations réalisées par le groupe BNP sur le territoire de Luxembourg et
• à contribuer à la maitrise de la charge fiscale du groupe BNP sur le même territoire.
  
CONCRÈTEMENT, VOTRE MISSION ET VOTRE QUOTIDIEN ?

Dans le cadre de vos fonctions, vous êtes amené à exercer les activités suivantes :

• Analyser et sécuriser, sur le plan fiscal, les opérations et produits mis en place par les métiers et entités du Groupe au Luxembourg et proposer des solutions alternatives pour répondre aux risques et contraintes identifiés.
• Apporter son expertise fiscale pour toutes opérations à dimension transfrontière de la banque ou des entités du Groupe au Luxembourg.
• Contribuer à la maitrise de la charge fiscale de la banque et des entités du Groupe au Luxembourg et revoir leurs déclarations fiscales.
• Assurer la liaison entre les métiers ou entités et les conseillers fiscaux externes (avocats, cabinets d'audit).
• Suivre les évolutions réglementaires fiscales en matière de fiscalité luxembourgeoise, européenne et internationale (OCDE) et analyser les implications pour la banque et les entités du Groupe au Luxembourg.
• Assurer une formation régulière sur les sujets fiscaux d'actualités.
• Assurer le suivi et participer à la validation des procédures internes de la banque comportant des aspects fiscaux.
  
LES MISSIONS C'EST IMPORTANT, L'ÉQUIPE ET L'ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL AUSSI !

Les apports de ce poste ?

Vous disposerez d'un large panel d'intervention dans les divers domaines d'activités de la banque au Luxembourg et ceci notamment en accompagnant les métiers/ fonctions/ entités du groupe dans leurs transactions locales ou transfrontières.
Votre rôle vous emmènera également sur des projets de plus grande envergure comme des fusions-acquisitions, opérations de leasing financier, accompagnement des entreprises en local ou encore des projets de développement durable.

Expérience Professionnelle : Vous avez une première expérience de 7 ans minimum en fiscalité luxembourgeoise et internationale des sociétés et vous souhaitez mettre à disposition vos connaissances acquises au service des métiers de la banque.

Compétences techniques

Connaissances linguistiques

title: Senior Relationship Manager - Multi Family Offices & Professional Intermediaries (m/f)
description:
Senior Relationship Manager - Multi Family Offices & Professional Intermediaries (M/F)
Luxembourg
req1027

Founded in 1856, Banque Internationale à Luxembourg is the oldest multi-business bank in the Grand Duchy. From its foundation, the BIL has always played an active role in the development of the Luxembourg economy. It currently operates in retail, private and corporate banking, as well as on major capital markets. Employing more than 2 000 people, BIL is present in the financial hotspots that are Luxembourg, Switzerland, and China.

As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Relationship Manager & Business Developer to support our growth and further develop our business relationships and client network with professional intermediaries (fiduciaries, family office, etc.) looking for a strong partner that is offering account management, investment and credit's solutions for domiciliation business activities run by holding companies.

This is a unique opportunity to join a dynamic and entrepreneurial working environment, a great team of experts sharing a clear vision and business strategy, and to get the chance to evolve in universal bank at human size, at the headquarters.    
The position is based in Luxembourg, you will join a team of ~6 Relationship Managers focusing on those specific activities, within the Wealth Management division of BIL.

Your next challenge:

• Develop your book of clients, with a defined growth strategy, fostering on building both long-term and trustworthy relationships with professional intermediaries, leveraging our full wealth management service's offering
• Manage and consolidate client relationships (B to B) with professional intermediaries, including fiduciaries, law firms, (Multi) Family Offices, economic advisors, etc., and be the primary point of contact for intermediaries as well as for end clients (B to C relationship).
• Cultivate existing relationships with professional intermediaries and end-clients, ensuring the delivery of exceptional service, and driving business growth through this existing client base.
• Leverage the right internal experts (i.e. Credit Structurer, Wealth Planner, Investment Officer, etc.) and collaborate across business lines to secure business leads.
• Maintain an extensive knowledge of the current market conditions to detect and/or anticipate possible commercial opportunities for the customers
• Attend internal and external events to develop your network and client's portfolio
• Analyze and/or reanalyze client files (mostly financial companies in the broad sense) to ensure that all regulatory aspects are duly fulfilled/compliant and, if necessary, collect and analyze all elements that enable a thorough remediation of our clients' files (KYC).
• Present (after thorough and meticulous analysis) the files that require it to the relevant committees.
• Collect, document, and understand the transactions carried out by clients (KYT).
• Manage more complex files (and/or wealthier clients, more complex investment products). Handle credit requests and present files to the relevant committees (CDC/CDE, etc.).

Your deliverables:

• Organize appointments and points of contact (regular client calls and visits).
• Provide advice to clients regarding the existing offerings (on all products offered by the bank). Help clients navigate financial offerings. Provide guidance on the existing offerings.
• Document all client information in CRM, including details about upcoming client events (e.g., contract signings, new investments).
• Master and comply with banking processes and regulatory obligations (KYC, AML, KYT, FIDLEG) and stay informed of all regulatory changes.
• Update the client's risk profile.
• Keep client records up to date (KYC, AML, etc.).
• Ensure consistency in the level of service provided by all CST members.
• Coordinate client events (conferences and sponsored activities, etc.) and organize key actions to acquire new clients.
• Share knowledge with more junior profiles by coaching them on office tools or bank programs, and as needed on specific products.

Your skills:

• Education: Master's degree in Finance (or equivalent experience in the field)
• A strong existing network and client base
• Excellent command of French and English
• Minimum of 8 years of experience in a similar function
• Good commercial sense / client and results orientation
• Good knowledge of the economic, legal, tax, and regulatory environment.
Basic knowledge of Wealth Planning / Credit Structuring, etc.
• Computer skills: T24, Salesforce, MS Office
• High analytical capacity, especially regarding KYC/AML, etc.
• Strong team spirit
• Organizational autonomy

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.
BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

Job Description

The Transport Manager acts as the operational backbone and system Subject Matter Expert (SME) for outbound transportation execution across the EMENA network at Avery Dennison. Reporting to the Head of Transportation, this role bridges strategic regional transport objectives with daily execution—overseeing both direct customer deliveries and internal site movements.
The position combines technical system ownership (TRAX TMS & QAD ERP), master data governance, order/lead-time investigations, carrier integration management, and operational standardization across all regional manufacturing plants and distribution centers.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

1. Transport System Governance & Network Master Data

• Lead-Time & Schedule Administration: Configure, validate, and maintain transport lead-time matrices per shipping site, destination country, and individual ship-to customer location across EMENA.
• Order Cut-Off & Departure Execution: Establish and maintain order entry cut-off times and daily departure schedules to align plant dispatch capabilities with carrier collection slots.
• Routing & Execution Logic: Maintain and optimize TRAX routing rules, logic parameters, and ship-via assignment rules per ship-to destination.
• Carrier & Partner Onboarding: Manage system setup and integration parameters for new logistics service providers following carrier tender allocation or carrier switches; maintain manual partner addresses as required.
• Documentation & Carrier EDI: Setup specific delivery instructions per ship-to to ensure dynamic printing on Weight-Lists and seamless EDI transmission to carriers; configure specialized invoicing setups (e.g., single weight-list per order rule).
• Network Availability & Calendars: Update and govern site and customer holiday closures to prevent system tendering errors and inaccurate delivery commitments.

2. ERP Integration & Analytical Investigations

• Custom Shipping Setup: Configure specialized shipping requirements in QAD, including the setup of "special pallet packlist" rules per ship-to upon request from Customer Service Representatives (CSRs).
• Lead-Time Root Cause Analysis: Conduct structured investigations into lead-time performance and anomalies (segmented by site, country, and ship-to) to resolve bottlenecks.
• Order Diagnostics: Lead end-to-end technical and operational investigations on delayed or stuck orders to identify system vs. operational execution root causes.

3. Outbound Network Governance & Service Excellence

• Oversee daily outbound freight flows, ensuring compliance with defined SLAs for customer deliveries and inter-site transfers.
• Track and report operational performance metrics (OTIF, OTD, weight-list compliance).
• Serve as the primary regional escalation contact for complex transport system failures, carrier delivery exceptions, and site logistics disruptions.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Customer Experience (CSR), Manufacturing Operations, Warehouse Logistics, and Carriers.
Please note it's a 24 month contract.

Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or Systems Engineering.
• Experience: 5+ years of operational transportation management or logistics systems experience within a complex, multi-site European/EMENA environment.
• Systems Expertise: Hands-on experience with TRAX TMS and QAD ERP transport modules (or equivalent enterprise TMS/ERP combinations); solid understanding of carrier EDI integrations and weight-list/invoicing documentation.
• Skills: Strong analytical capabilities (root-cause analysis on orders and lead-times), continuous improvement mindset, cross-functional communication.
• Languages: Professional fluency in English; additional European languages (German, French, Dutch, Polish) are an advantage.

Additional Information

Here's a glimpse of the great benefits you can expect:

• Compensation & Benefits: Benefit from a labor agreement with salary increases, a qualified social minimum wage, and automatic salary indexation to inflation. Enjoy a seniority incentive, profit sharing, and a 13th-month salary (with the option to convert it into additional leave).

• Flexibility & On-site Perks: Embrace flexible work arrangements for white-collar roles. Enjoy a subsidized canteen, an annual gift for employees and children, and a mobile app that centralizes services, benefits, vouchers, and discounts.

description:
Language: English (UK)

------Service Now - copy&paste-Position: AC-50016322

About us
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The University's main Library, the Luxembourg Learning Centre (LLC), located in the heart of the Belval campus, is much more than a library: it is a hub of innovation and knowledge designed to foster research, learning, collaboration and outreach. Its building, a true architectural masterpiece, combines the restructuring of an old industrial hall with bold contemporary design, and spans 14,000 m², 10.7 km of shelving and more a thousand working spaces. It stands as a prestigious façade for Luxembourg and for the University of Luxembourg, reflecting the ambition and academic excellence of both the country and the institution. Equipped with modern infrastructure and advanced technologies, the LLC offers a unique environment where students, researchers, and professionals come together to create, share and innovate. Complementing the central role of the LLC in Belval, a library hub specialising in European law research is located in the Weicker building, benefiting from its proximity to European institutions and Luxembourg's financial district.

Your role
We are looking for a specialist in the Library's strategic growth area of research support and information skills training. Based in Belval, with the opportunity to offer support and training at our other campus locations in Luxembourg, the person will be involved in developing new innovative research support services around research data management, in collaboration with colleagues and senior managers. You will also contribute to developing the information skills training programmes in partnership with the learning and teaching centres of the University. You will help to promote the development of the Library's emerging research support services.
Key Responsibilities:
• Contribute to the development and implementation of research support services, policies, and future service planning
• Provide specialist support for the University's research activities, with a priority on research data management, and additional support around open science, open access, bibliometrics, and scholarly communication
• Assist with the development and management of institutional data and publishing repositories, e.g. contributing to efforts in data quality, compliance with funder requirements, and timely deposit of research outputs
• Support day to day operations of the Library's Research Support team, including responding to enquiries and maintaining service documentation
• Develop and deliver training, workshops, and one to one consultations for researchers, students - bachelor, master and doctoral, and academic research support staff
• Establish and maintain strong working relationships with researchers and students, as well as across the Library and research support services, to establish requirements and inform service delivery
• Promote all research support services of the Library
• Contribute to the development of Library policies and practices
It is anticipated that 80% of the role involves outreach and development of research support services, and 20% of the role involves developing and providing training in information skills topics, e.g. research data management, information literacy and use of digital tools.

Your profile
• Master's degree or equivalent professional experience in an academic, research, digital, or information-intensive environment
• 3+ years' experience in research support environments with a focus on research data management
• In depth knowledge in research data management and related trends
• Library and/or teaching experience is an asset
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to engage diverse stakeholders and promote services
• A PhD is considered an asset
• Full proficiency in English; good knowledge of French or German would be an asset

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply
Applications should include:
• Curriculum Vitae
• Cover letter
Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception. Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by Email will not be considered.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg promotes an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to upholding equality and respect for our employees and students.

title: Service Level Manager & Performance Data/IA (m/f)
description:
Service Level Manager & Performance Data/IA

Sur un marché de plus en plus exigeant et concurrentiel, notre organisation place l'excellence opérationnelle, l'innovation et l'amélioration continue au cœur de sa stratégie. Dans le cadre du renforcement de notre Direction des Systèmes d'Information, nous recherchons un(e) : Service Level Manager & Data/IA (h/f)

Vos missions

Au sein de l'équipe Service Delivery Management de la DSI Production, vous jouez un rôle clé dans la construction et l'industrialisation du pilotage de la performance opérationnelle. Vous transformez les données issues du monitoring, des outils ITSM et des fournisseurs en indicateurs pertinents, tableaux de bord décisionnels et analyses à forte valeur ajoutée.

Votre mission consiste également à faire évoluer le Service Level Management vers un pilotage proactif, prédictif et automatisé grâce à l'exploitation de la donnée et de l'intelligence artificielle.

Concevoir le dispositif de pilotage de la Production

• Recueillir et formaliser les besoins de pilotage des équipes Production, des Service Delivery Managers, des métiers et des fournisseurs.
• Définir et maintenir un référentiel cohérent de KPI, KRI, SLA, SLO et OLA.
• Concevoir et développer des tableaux de bord opérationnels, managériaux et exécutifs.
• Mettre en place des dispositifs de reporting adaptés aux différents publics : équipes techniques, management DSI, métiers et partenaires externes.

Industrialiser la collecte et la qualité des données

• Cartographier les différentes sources de données : monitoring, observabilité, ITSM, CMDB, infrastructures, cloud et fournisseurs.
• Définir et implémenter une stratégie d'alerting basée sur des seuils de performance et de criticité.
• Automatiser les flux de collecte, d'analyse et de publication des indicateurs.
• Garantir la qualité, la cohérence et la traçabilité des données.
• Documenter les modèles de données, les règles de gestion et le catalogue des indicateurs.
• Superviser le cycle de vie des environnements IT et assurer leur stabilité opérationnelle.

Développer un Service Level Management augmenté par l'IA

• Identifier et prioriser les cas d'usage IA à forte valeur ajoutée.
• Mettre en œuvre des solutions d'analyse prédictive, de détection d'anomalies et de corrélation d'événements.
• Automatiser la production des synthèses de performance, des reportings et des recommandations d'actions.
• Développer des capacités de requêtage en langage naturel sur les données de Production.
• Définir les règles de gouvernance et les garde-fous nécessaires à l'usage responsable de l'IA.
• Mesurer les bénéfices apportés par les solutions d'intelligence artificielle.

Animer la performance et l'amélioration continue

• Préparer et animer les revues de services, comités de performance et comités SLA.
• Analyser les écarts de performance et piloter les plans d'amélioration.
• Challenger les niveaux de service afin d'optimiser l'équilibre entre qualité, coûts et besoins métiers.
• Accompagner les équipes dans l'adoption d'une culture orientée données et résultats.

Votre profil

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme supérieur de niveau Bac+5 en informatique, data, ingénierie, management des systèmes d'information ou domaine équivalent.
• Vous disposez d'une expérience professionnelle d'au moins 5 ans dans les domaines de la Production IT, du Service Delivery Management, du Service Level Management, de la Data/BI ou de l'observabilité.
• Vous possédez une excellente connaissance des bonnes pratiques ITIL, notamment en gestion des niveaux de service, incidents, problèmes, changements et capacités.
• Vous maîtrisez les outils de Business Intelligence (Power BI, Tableau ou équivalent), SQL et les principes de modélisation de données.
• Vous avez une bonne connaissance des API, mécanismes ETL/ELT et des outils d'automatisation ; la maîtrise de Python constitue un atout.
• Vous comprenez les concepts et usages de l'IA générative et du machine learning appliqués aux opérations IT.
• Vous êtes sensibilisé(e) aux enjeux de sécurité, confidentialité, gouvernance et auditabilité des données.
• Reconnu(e) pour votre esprit d'analyse et votre rigueur, vous savez transformer des données complexes en informations claires et exploitables.
• Vous faites preuve d'un excellent sens du service, d'une forte orientation résultats et d'une capacité à fédérer des interlocuteurs variés.
• Curieux(se) et innovant(e), vous êtes force de proposition et appréciez les environnements en transformation.
• Vous disposez d'excellentes capacités de communication en français, à l'écrit comme à l'oral. La maîtrise de l'anglais professionnel constitue un avantage.

Nous offrons

• Un environnement de travail innovant et orienté transformation digitale.
• La possibilité de contribuer à des projets stratégiques mêlant Data, IA et performance des services IT.
• Une collaboration étroite avec des équipes multidisciplinaires et des partenaires de premier plan.
• Des opportunités de développement professionnel et de montée en compétences sur les technologies émergentes.
• Un cadre favorisant l'autonomie, l'innovation et l'amélioration continue.
• Un équilibre entre performance, qualité de vie au travail et flexibilité organisationnelle.

title: Senior Business Development Manager-Multi Family Offices&Professional Intermediar (m/f)
description:
Senior Business Development Manager – Multi Family Offices & Professional Intermediaries (M/F)

Luxembourg | req786

Founded in 1856, Banque Internationale à Luxembourg is the oldest multi-business bank in the Grand Duchy. From its foundation, the BIL has always played an active role in the development of the Luxembourg economy. It currently operates in retail, private and corporate banking, as well as on major capital markets. Employing more than 2 000 people, BIL is present in the financial hotspots that are Luxembourg, Switzerland, and China.

As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Business Developer to join our team, focusing on Multi/Single Family Offices & Professional Intermediaries. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying and cultivating relationships with professional intermediaries and clients, driving business growth, and ensuring the delivery of exceptional service. The position is based in Luxembourg and you will report to the Head of Multi Family Offices & Professional Intermediaries.

• A strong international network of MFO/SFO & Professional Intermediaries
• Strong analytical skills, particularly in KYC/AML compliance

title: Depositary Services Senior Representative - Alternative Funds (Fixed-term) (m/f)
description:
At BBH, Partnership is more than a form of ownership-it's our approach to business and relationships.  We know that supporting your professional and personal goals is the best way to help our clients and advance our business. We take that responsibility seriously. With a 200-year legacy and a shared passion for what's next, this is the right place to build a fulfilling career.

Depositary Services Senior Representative - Alternative Funds (Fixed-term)

BBH is currently recruiting a Depositary Services Senior Representative to join our dynamic Depositary Services team. In this key role you will be responsible for the coordination and performance of tasks relating to the supervision of assets of Real Estate, Private Debt and Private Equity funds. In addition, you will assess, analyze, and monitor risks and control issues for the products and services falling under the scope of the Depositary obligations.  You will have a high level of technical acumen and analytical skills in order to foster a solution orientated and consultative approach to performing our Depositary obligations

Key Responsibilities:

• Gather and review documentation received in relation to recordkeeping and verification of ownership of real assets (real estate, private debt, private equity, fund of funds) and proactively monitor the status and completion of those tasks and follow up to obtain required client documentation
• Build Strong relationships with Clients and have the knowledge and ability to explain the regulatory drivers behind these requirements
• Review and/or execute daily cash flow monitoring activities by gathering information and reviewing exceptions
• Support team in determining appropriate resolutions to new regulatory obligations.
• Monitor, report, define and document critical internal control processes.
• Formulate corrective actions, where applicable, to resolve identified exceptions.
• Coordinate internal and external projects in an efficient and thorough manner.
• Prepare and review documentation for regulators and external auditors
• Support Team on questions from clients, regulators, external auditors and/or BBH internal departments. Communicate clearly with business area contacts as well as other areas of the Bank
• Maintain effective working relationships at relevant levels with other departments
• Escalate within the team significant audit issues, set direction/communicate proposed manner of resolution of audit issues and concerns that have a significant impact
• Develop and maintain peer relationships to share best practices

Qualifications:

1. Education level and/ or experience

• Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting
• 2 to 4 years' experience working within the alternative funds industry or relevant business line experience
• Proficient Business level German skills are considered as an advantage

2. Knowledge and skills

• Excellent analytical, communication and interpersonal skills with ability to present complex and sensitive issues
• Technical skills in alternatives and regulation
• Good knowledge in European and local regulatory requirements
• Demonstrates Microsoft Office skills (with emphasis placed on Excel proficiency).
• Ability to learn and adapt to new technologies and systems
• Ability to identify, escalate and resolve a problem.
• Ability to communicate professionally through effective verbal and written skills.
• Ability to manage time efficiently and effectively.
• Organizational skills and detail-oriented.
• Ability to work in a team environment.
• Ability to meet deadlines and work under pressure.
• Ability to manage and inspire people

We value diverse experiences. We value diverse experiences and transferrable skillsets. If your career hasn't followed a traditional path, includes alternative experiences, or doesn't meet every qualification or skill listed in the job description, please do go ahead and apply.

About BBH:

Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH) is a premier global financial services firm, known for premium service, specialist expertise, technology solutions and partnership approach to client management. Across Investor Services and Capital Partners, we work with an enviable roster of sophisticated clients who make BBH their first call when they are tackling their hardest challenges. Delivering for our clients and each other energizes us.

We believe that how we do our work is just as important as what we do. The Transport Manager acts as the operational backbone and system Subject Matter Expert (SME) for outbound transportation execution across the EMENA network at Avery Dennison. Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

1. Transport System Governance & Network Master Data

• Lead-Time & Schedule Administration: Configure, validate, and maintain transport lead-time matrices per shipping site, destination country, and individual ship-to customer location across EMENA.
• Order Cut-Off & Departure Execution: Establish and maintain order entry cut-off times and daily departure schedules to align plant dispatch capabilities with carrier collection slots.

• Carrier & Partner Onboarding: Manage system setup and integration parameters for new logistics service providers following carrier tender allocation or carrier switches; maintain manual partner addresses as required.

• Custom Shipping Setup: Configure specialized shipping requirements in QAD, including the setup of "special pallet packlist" rules per ship-to upon request from Customer Service Representatives (CSRs).
• Lead-Time Root Cause Analysis: Conduct structured investigations into lead-time performance and anomalies (segmented by site, country, and ship-to) to resolve bottlenecks.
• Order Diagnostics: Lead end-to-end technical and operational investigations on delayed or stuck orders to identify system vs. operational execution root causes.

3. Outbound Network Governance & Service Excellence

• Oversee daily outbound freight flows, ensuring compliance with defined SLAs for customer deliveries and inter-site transfers.
• Track and report operational performance metrics (OTIF, OTD, weight-list compliance).
• Serve as the primary regional escalation contact for complex transport system failures, carrier delivery exceptions, and site logistics disruptions.

Please note it's a 24 month contract.

Qualifications

• Systems Expertise: Hands-on experience with TRAX TMS and QAD ERP transport modules (or equivalent enterprise TMS/ERP combinations); solid understanding of carrier EDI integrations and weight-list/invoicing documentation.
• Skills: Strong analytical capabilities (root-cause analysis on orders and lead-times), continuous improvement mindset, cross-functional communication.
• Languages: Professional fluency in English; additional European languages (German, French, Dutch, Polish) are an advantage.

About us
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Law, Economics and Finance counts over 2,700 students enrolled across four Bachelor programmes, thirteen Master programmes, doctoral studies as well as several continuing education courses. The Faculty hosts the Doctoral School of Law and the Doctoral School in Economics, Finance and Management.
Teaching and research at the FDEF benefit from the proximity of European institutions, Luxembourg's leading international financial centre, as well as its vibrant business community. Institutional and private sector partnerships, sponsored chairs and a growing network of international partner universities make the FDEF a dynamic academic hub at the heart of Europe.

Your role
The successful candidate will strengthen the Department of Law's research area in Banking, Financial and Commercial Law, which is a cornerstone of the Department's academic profile and a key contributor to the University's reputation. They will pursue research and teaching in this field, focussing on Luxembourg, EU, and comparative transnational perspectives. The position is of particular strategic relevance given the Department's ambition to maintain its leadership in financial law, a domain central to Luxembourg's role as a global financial centre.
The ideal candidate shows potential to:
• Develop an internationally recognized research profile in banking law in a broad sense, e.g., prudential regulation and bank supervision, depositary law, regulation of payments and payment systems, financial technologies, sustainable finance, secured transactions and consumer financial contracts, links to financial markets law
• Publish extensively in top-tier peer-reviewed journals, monographs, or authoritative treatises
• Contribute to interdisciplinary initiatives such as the FutureFinTechNCER and/or collaborate with the Department of Finance in the field of sustainable finance
• Teach in core areas of banking law. The ability to contribute to teaching in related areas of commercial law—such as financial and securities law, company law, insolvency law, the law of commercial contracts and torts - is an asset
• Cover legal frameworks at both EU and Luxembourg levels, adopting a comparative approach that includes neighbouring jurisdictions and other global financial centres
• Engage with Luxembourg and EU regulators (e.g. CSSF, CBL, ECB, ESMA), international organizations, e.g. IOSCO, BIS, FSB, etc., and other stakeholders, e.g. (inter )national law firms, industry and academic associations
• Acquire competitive research funding and establish and lead their own research team
• Show and develop leadership potential
The candidate will join one of Europe's most prominent academic groups in banking and financial law, distinguished by both its intellectual strength and research output. They will actively contribute to the University's “Third Mission” by engaging with Luxembourg and EU financial law, and will be encouraged to develop into a leadership role within the Department. This position offers the opportunity to gain recognition and respect in Luxembourg's legal community, renowned for its emphasis on financial law expertise and its strong integration of academic insight with professional practice. Their doctoral students will benefit from a strong academic environment and excellent career prospects—more than 20 former PhD graduates from the Department have gone on to become professors.

Your profile
• A Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD degree in Law
• Experience and interest in engaging in academic research at the highest level
• Publications in internationally recognized journals, monographs with international publishers or other publications in banking law (or other fields of financial law) indicating potential for excellent research
• Potential and aptitude for teaching and supervising research at the university level
• An excellent academic track record demonstrating both scholarly excellence and leadership potential
• Experience with externally funded research projects and interdisciplinarity is considered to be an asset
• Experience in interdisciplinary research—particularly at the intersection of law, finance, and technology—is a strong asset
The successful candidate must commit to lecturing banking law, as well as related topics in financial and commercial law, at bachelor and master levels.
The successful candidate is also expected to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, prepare grant applications for external funding and actively engage with other research institutions and industry partners to establish research cooperations in Luxembourg and beyond.
Language requirements:
The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and French. Knowledge of German is considered an advantage. The University actively supports language development among its staff and offers access to language courses to this end.

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research-Intensive Universities.
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance

How to apply
Online application should include:

All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. We encourage early application. To ensure full consideration, candidates should apply by of 29/04/2026.

title: Supply Chain Manager, Capacity Execution, AMXL EU Supply Chain Execution (m/f)
description:
Supply Chain Manager, Capacity Execution, AMXL EU Supply Chain Execution
Job ID: 10533977 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. One customer experience that we're constantly looking to take to a new level is how we fulfil and deliver customer orders. Amazon aims to exceed the expectations of our customers by ensuring that their orders, no matter how large or small, are delivered as quickly, accurately, and as cost effectively as possible.
Amazon's Supply Chain Managers play a central role in our global business. They keep our complex, international supply chains working seamlessly and efficiently. As a Supply Chain Manager in Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) EU, you will work closely with multiple stakeholders across Amazon, from operational teams who are fulfilling customer orders to retail teams and everything in between. You'll help us optimise our supply chains to make our customer experience even better and our business more energy and cost efficient.
As AMXL EU Sr. Supply Chain Manager, Capacity Execution, you will be responsible for managing significant operational and service growth across our European operations as well as implementing standardised process and quality for our Amazon two-person / special handling delivery service. To succeed in this role, you need to be comfortable making business decisions in a fast-paced and evolving work environment and partnering with various functional teams and individuals at all levels of the organisation. This role will include a mix of long-term strategic projects and short-term tactical scope. You will bring strong business judgment, deep curiosity about how things work, strong written and oral communication skills, and a passion for creating effective processes and mechanisms that scale.
The role is responsible for the Production Planning, Labour Planning, and Capacity Execution function for AMXL EU, and is located in our Luxembourg Amazon HQ office, with Barcelona corporate offices also available as an option.
You will collaborate with and present to senior stakeholders to shape network-level strategic decisions. You will bring an analytical background that enables you to support network planning and demonstrate the ability to think broadly and strategically about operational initiatives. You will experience a wide range of problem-solving situations, requiring extensive use of data collection and analysis, in partnership with teams including fulfilment operations leadership, HR, finance, supply chain, transportation, and global system development.

Key job responsibilities

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Be responsible for Fulfilment Centre, Sort Centre, and Inbound Cross-Dock Labour and Production Planning, Capacity Execution, as well as cost and service optimisation for the EU AMXL network
• Partner with and present to senior leadership, business and finance stakeholders to gather and share data-driven insights
• Support input forecasting using trend analysis and statistical modelling to support decision-making
• Build short, medium, and long-term operational plans to minimise variable costs associated with staffing
• Analyse and solve business problems with a focus on understanding root causes and identifying forward-looking opportunities
• Communicate complex analysis and insights to stakeholders and business leaders, both verbally and in writing
• Participate in global operational and production planning initiatives and project rollouts to support growing business needs
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to promote process improvement and standardisation across all sites in the network

A day in the life

Being a Supply Chain Manager for Amazon involves lots of problem solving. You'll work with a number of teams to navigate challenges as and when situations impact our network. You'll spend time resolving temporary issues and looking at the bigger picture to help Amazon achieve new objectives. This role is both proactive and reactive, and you'll have the opportunity to help forecast and plan for new projects.
As a Supply Chain Manager, you'll need to help with both operational tasks and more tactical work. No two days will be the same. You could spend one day helping to define our supply chain and operating models and the next assisting with a site's resource plan for a busy period. Having so much variety in your role means you'll be able to learn something new every day.
This role is based at one of our European headquarters in Luxembourg, or at our Barcelona corporate offices.

About the team

Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) looks after heavy and bulky items like furniture and large home appliances. Our team manages the entire service, from supply chain fulfilment, to delivery and returns. What sets this service apart from others is the extra level of customer care. Not only do we deliver large items, but we unpack, assemble and install them, and take away old items where needed. With a focus on safety, productivity and innovation, we're changing the way customers buy and receive large goods for the better.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field
- Experience working with databases and SQL
- Experience in project or program management
- Experience with operations/supply chain
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, managing end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Experience leading process improvements
- Knowledge of SQL at an intermediate level, including: compile queries, subqueries, aggregation/grouping, data modification, etc.

Have you ever ordered a product on Amazon and, when the box arrived, you wondered how it got to you so fast? Have you wondered where it came from and how much it cost Amazon to deliver it to you?
Amazon Logistics (AMZL) is Amazon's "Last Mile" delivery service, responsible for delivering packages to customers across the world. The AMZL network is undergoing rapid growth and change on a global scale.

Our teams are changing the way we interact with customers every single day and solving some of the biggest logistical challenges facing not just Amazon, but the entire industry. AMZL is developing an innovative world-class Last Mile operation with a portfolio of buildings, vehicles, and technology to deliver customers' packages on time and tailored to our ever-changing customer expectations. AMZL Finance teams partner closely with global cross-functional business and tech teams to support this rapidly expanding business; driving controllership, innovation, productivity, and cost-effective operations across the network in a fast paced environment.

Our business is delivering smiles to our customers by ensuring on-time deliveries with the highest quality in a safe environment where people like to come to work every day. You will make history as you help build one of the largest carriers on the planet while having fun.

Key job responsibilities

• Leverages Amazon Logistic metrics to identify cost out opportunities by linking up operations and financials. Understands the details of the cost structure to make thoughtful judgement calls in ambiguous environments where data may be difficult to procure.

• Owns the Financial and operational planning processes to produce a challenging/stretch/bold yet solid operational plan. Owns all Month-end procedures including accruals and variance analysis between scenarios (actuals, Plan, Forecast...)

We are looking for a Senior Financial Analyst that is excited to join a tech company that is constantly improving and reimagining the logistics industry. Our candidate should be passionate about using data to solve big, complex and ambiguous problems. The ideal candidate should be eager to continuously learn and improve their skills. title: Kundenservice / Online Presenter (Koreanisch & Englisch) – Malta (Kundendienstberater/in)
description:
Für einen internationalen Technologie- und Entertainment-Kunden in Malta suchen wir koreanischsprachige Kandidaten für eine kundenorientierte Online-Rolle in einem professionellen Studio-Umfeld.
Vorerfahrung ist nicht erforderlich – eine umfassende Schulung wird angeboten.

We are recruiting Korean-speaking Online Presenters / Customer Service Representatives for a global technology company based in Malta.

In this role, you will work from a professional studio environment, engaging with online users and delivering a high-quality, interactive digital experience. No previous experience is required — full training is provided.

Key Responsibilities

- Host and present interactive online sessions from a live studio
- Engage with users in a professional, friendly, and customer-focused manner
- Maintain high presentation and service standards at all times
- Participate in internal initiatives and promotional activities
- Follow company procedures and quality standards
- Report any operational or technical issues to supervisors
- Maintain a clean and professional working environment

Requirements

- No previous experience required – full training provided
- Fluent Korean
- Conversational English (B1 or above)
- Willingness to work a 24/7 rotating shift pattern (including weekends and public holidays)
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills
- Comfortable working in a multicultural, international environment

Benefits

- Competitive salary
- Up to €400 monthly performance bonus
- €400 annual wellness allowance
- Night shift allowance
- Monthly transport allowance (€70)
- Monthly food allowance
- Retention allowance
- Life insurance (2x annual salary)
- Private health insurance from day one
- Free access to on-site gym
- Company events and social activities
- Snacks and fruit provided at the workplace

Note: German language skills are not required. Relocation to Malta is supported.

title: Kundenbetreuer (m/w/d) – Umzug nach Malta ( Umzugspaket inklusive ) (Berufsspezialist/in - Vertrieb)
description:
Als deutschsprachiger Kundenbetreuer (Customer Account Advisor) bist du Teil eines europäischen Kundenserviceteams und unterstützt internationale Kundinnen und Kunden direkt von unserem Büro im sonnigen Malta aus.

Du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für eine Vielzahl von Anfragen rund um Kundenkonten und sorgst für ein positives Serviceerlebnis.

Diese Position wird in Vollzeit angeboten und erfordert flexible Arbeitszeiten. Um dem vollen Sportkalender gerecht zu werden, arbeitest du im Schichtsystem an fünf von sieben Tagen – Wochenend- und Feiertagsarbeit ist regelmäßig vorgesehen.

Die Stelle ist Teil eines hybriden Arbeitsmodells – du arbeitest sowohl von zu Hause als auch im modernen Büro im Zentrum von Sliema, mit Meerblick und Zugang zu zahlreichen Freizeitmöglichkeiten.

Was wir bieten

- Vollständiges Umzugspaket (Details unten)
- Attraktives Jahresbruttogehalt von ca. 34.600 €
- Gehaltszuschläge abhängig von Arbeitszeiten
- Lebens- und Krankenversicherung
- Kostenlose Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaft
- Zusätzliche 5 % deines Bruttojahresgehalts als Altersvorsorge
- Hybrides Arbeitsmodell (Homeoffice + Büro)
- Umfassende Einarbeitung und kontinuierliches Coaching
- Interne Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten

Relocation-Paket

- 6 Wochen kostenlose Unterkunft bei Ankunft
- Rückerstattung des Flugtickets (bis zu 285 €)
- 800 € monatlicher Wohnzuschuss in den ersten 6 Monaten
- Zusätzlich 100 € monatlich in den ersten 6 Monaten für Heimflüge

Deine Aufgaben

- Kundenbetreuung via Live-Chat und E-Mail
- Bearbeitung von Anfragen zu Zahlungen, Verifizierung, technischen Themen und allgemeinen Kontofragen
- Eskalation komplexer Fälle an Fachabteilungen
- Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams zur effizienten Problemlösung

Was du mitbringst

- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse
- Gute Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2)
- Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung
- Lösungsorientiertes Denken
- Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit, inklusive Wochenenden

Bereit für deinen Karrierestart unter der Sonne?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem englischen Lebenslauf – wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: Kundeservice søges til Malta - Betalt relokation
description:
Kundeservice søges til Malta – God løn, bonus og relocation-pakke

Kunne du tænke dig at kombinere en international karriere med livet på Malta?

Vi søger lige nu en dansktalende Kundeservice til en langsigtet stilling hos en international bank på Malta.

Du bliver en del af et professionelt team, hvor du arbejder med danske kunder og får mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer inden for kundeservice, salg og den finansielle sektor.

Stillingen er særligt interessant for dig, der allerede har erfaring med kundeservice eller salg – og måske har erfaring som Team Leader eller med KPI'er og dataanalyse.

OM JOBBET

Som Kundeservice bliver du en del af et team, der håndterer kundeservice, onboarding, salg og betalinger.

Du vil blandt andet:

• Besvare kundehenvendelser via telefon, live chat, email og SMS

• Hjælpe kunder med information om bankens produkter, services og betalinger

• Håndtere spørgsmål og henvendelser fra danske kunder

• Arbejde tæt sammen med betalings- og collectionsafdelingen

• Følge gældende procedurer, regler og lovgivning

• Arbejde med salg og aktivt identificere relevante salgsmuligheder

• Sikre en professionel og effektiv kundeoplevelse

Du refererer direkte til den danske Team Leader og bliver en del af et internationalt arbejdsmiljø.

HVORFOR MALTA?

Malta er en populær destination for danskere, der ønsker at kombinere arbejde med livet i udlandet.

Her får du mulighed for at bo på en middelhavsø med et internationalt miljø, gode strande, restauranter, et aktivt socialt liv og masser af muligheder for at opleve øen.

Virksomheden arrangerer blandt andet ugentlige Friday Drinks og forskellige sociale arrangementer, hvor du kan lære dine kollegaer og Malta bedre at kende.

HVAD FÅR DU?

✈️ Op til €1.000 i relocation-refusion til kandidater, der flytter til Malta

Refusionen kan blandt andet bruges til fly, taxi og dokumenterede udgifter i forbindelse med flytningen

God Løn

10% bonus udbetalt kvartalsvist

Mulighed for yderligere bonus efter 6 måneders ansættelse

️ 24 feriedage + 14 helligdage

Health & Life Insurance efter 6 måneders prøvetid

Gratis frugt, brød og morgenmadsprodukter på arbejdspladsen

Friday Drinks og andre sociale arrangementer

Gode muligheder for intern udvikling – både til andre afdelinger og management

Langsigtet kontrakt

HVEM ER DU?

Vi leder efter dig, der:

• Har gode engelskkundskaber både skriftligt og mundtligt

• Har erfaring fra kundeservice eller salg

• Er vant til at arbejde med KPI'er og data

• Er engageret, professionel og ansvarsbevidst

• Kan arbejde struktureret og følge procedurer

• Er god til at kommunikere med kunder og kollegaer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra kundeservice, salg eller den finansielle sektor, men det vigtigste er, at du er engageret, professionel og pålidelig.

PRAKTISK INFORMATION

Malta – Msida

Fuldtid

40 timer om ugen

Langsigtet kontrakt

1 dags oplæring

6 måneders prøvetid

Opfølgende reviews efter 1, 3 og 6 måneder

Hvis du gerne vil tage næste skridt i din karriere, samtidig med at du får mulighed for at bo og arbejde på Malta, er dette en spændende mulighed.

Der er en ledig stilling.

Ansøg allerede i dag.
Mathias@jobsqd.com

Über uns

Die RCT Energy Technology GmbH mit Sitz in Konstanz ist ein technologieorientiertes Unternehmen im Bereich Energiespeichersysteme und intelligenter Energielösungen.

Unser Tätigkeitsfeld umfasst Energiespeichersysteme, Wechselrichter, Batterielösungen und Energiemanagementsysteme für private, gewerbliche, industrielle und großtechnische Anwendungen. Dabei stehen technische Innovation, Produktqualität, zuverlässige Projektabwicklung und die Anforderungen unserer Kunden im Mittelpunkt.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen After-Sales Engineer (m/w/d) für Batteriespeichersysteme mit Arbeitsort in den Niederlanden.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Sicherstellung eines hochwertigen technischen Supports und Projektmanagements für unsere CESS-Systeme und gewerblichen Speicherlösungen.
• Planung und Koordination von Installations- und Inbetriebnahmeeinsätzen in Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Partnern.
• Überwachung und Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Service-Level-Agreements (SLA) sowie Wartungsvereinbarungen.
• Analyse und Behebung technischer Störungen per Remote-Support oder vor Ort einschließlich der Organisation der erforderlichen Ersatzteilversorgung.

• Aufbau und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung eines projektbezogenen Berichtssystems zur Nachverfolgung und Optimierung der Supportprozesse.
• Bearbeitung technischer Anfragen über das zentrale Servicepostfach sowie systematische Erfassung und Nachverfolgung der Vorgänge im Ticketsystem.
• Bearbeitung und Nachverfolgung von Rückgabe- und Reklamationsverfahren (RMA) für CESS- und RESS-Systeme.

Ihr Profil

• Erfolgreich abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung oder ein Studium, vorzugsweise in Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
• Erfahrung im technischen Kundensupport oder im Servicebereich von Energiespeichersystemen ist von Vorteil.

• Sehr gute Englisch- oder Deutschkenntnisse; Chinesischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
• Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Dienstreisen.
• Gültiger Führerschein und praktische Fahrerfahrung; ein eigenes Fahrzeug ist von Vorteil.

Wir bieten

• Eine anspruchsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem dynamischen und zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen der erneuerbaren Energien.
• Die Möglichkeit, innovative großtechnische Batteriespeicherlösungen aktiv mitzugestalten und einen Beitrag zu einer nachhaltigen Energiezukunft zu leisten.

title: Failure Test Engineer
description:
Failure Analysis Engineer (Test) Wij zijn op zoek naar een Failure Analysis Engineer die enthousiast is over het achterhalen van de kernoorzaak van technische problemen en het continu verbeteren van processen in een dynamische, internationale werkomgeving. Heb jij een technische achtergrond, maar steek je ook graag zelf de handen uit de mouwen aan machines? Dan is dit de perfecte kans voor jou! Werkzaamheden Uitvoeren van Root Cause Analyses (RCA) op complexe elektronische en mechatronische systemen die retour komen van klanten of vanuit onze interne productie. Jouw bevindingen zijn essentieel voor het kwaliteitsteam bij het definiëren van verbeteringen en het oplossen van faalmodi. Samenwerken met kwaliteits-, ontwikkelings- en productieafdelingen om problemen op te lossen en de betrouwbaarheid van producten te verbeteren. Ondernemers zoeken geen advocaat die jurisprudentie uit zijn mouw schudt of indrukwekkende adviezen schrijft waar niemand verder mee komt. Zij zoeken iemand die begrijpt wat er in hun bedrijf speelt, helder communiceert en het probleem daadwerkelijk oplost. Iemand die eerlijk zegt wanneer procederen verstandig is, maar ook wanneer dat niet is.
Dat is precies hoe wij werken.

Als Advocaat bij De Neef Advocaten krijg je vanaf de eerste dag je eigen dossiers. Je bent niet degene die achter de schermen concepten schrijft voor een ander. Jij doet het intakegesprek, adviseert, onderhandelt, schrijft processtukken, gaat naar de zitting en bepaalt samen met je cliënt de beste strategie. Jij bent het aanspreekpunt en bouwt een relatie op met je cliënten. title: Industriële Schilders
description:
Het uitvoeren van industriële schilder‑ en oppervlaktebehandelingswerkzaamheden met als doel het duurzaam beschermen van industriële installaties, staalconstructies, machines, leidingen en opslagtanks tegen corrosie, chemicaliën, slijtage en overige invloeden. Dit gebeurt volgens geldende veiligheidsnormen, kwaliteitsrichtlijnen en projectspecificaties.

Verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Voorbereiden van oppervlakken door reinigen, ontvetten, schuren (manueel of machinaal) en stralen.
  • Aanbrengen van primers, laklagen, epoxy‑coatings, polyurethaan‑coatings en andere beschermsystemen.
  • Uitvoeren van kwaliteitscontroles zoals droge en natte laagdiktemetingen, visuele inspecties en hechtingscontroles, temperatuur- en luchtvochtigheidsmetingen en ruwheidsmetingen.
  • Correct instellen en bedienen van schilder-, straal‑ en spuitapparatuur.
  • Afdekken en beschermen van niet‑te‑behandelen zones.
  • Signaleren van afwijkingen, beschadigingen of corrosieproblemen en uitvoeren van herstelwerkzaamheden.
  • Registreren van uitgevoerde werkzaamheden en gebruikte materialen.
  • Werken volgens veiligheidsinstructies (VCA), inclusief correcte inzet van PBM’s.
  • Eventueel ondersteunen bij brandwerende, chemisch resistente of hygiënische coatings.
  • In teamverband samenwerken met (meewerkende) voormannen en inspecteurs.

Je hebt geen hoogtevrees en je bent een echte teamplayer. Je bent bereid om nieuwe zaken te leren zodat je op rustigere momenten multidisciplinair inzetbaar bent.

title: Graafmaschinist (m/v/x) (Tiefbaufacharbeiter/in (ohne Angabe des Schwerpunkts))
description:
Graafmachinist 16 ton (m/v/x)

AA Schroefpalen B.V. | Malden (Gelderland) | Fulltime | Per direct

Het belangrijkste op een rij

- Werkgebied: projectlocaties door heel Nederland
- Fulltime dienstverband
- Uitzicht op een vast contract
- Salaris boven de cao Bouw & Infra
- 45 vrije dagen per jaar
- Moderne machines en materieel
- Opleidingen en certificaten kunnen via AA Schroefpalen worden behaald

Over AA Schroefpalen

AA Schroefpalen is gespecialiseerd in trillingsvrije funderingsoplossingen. Vanuit onze vestiging in Malden realiseren wij funderingsprojecten door heel Nederland.

Met moderne funderingsmachines, graafmachines en digitaal boormanagement zorgen wij voor een veilige, efficiënte en nauwkeurige uitvoering van onze projecten.

AA Schroefpalen is onderdeel van de Possehl Group en werkt nauw samen met de Duitse zusteronderneming JACBO Pfahlgründungen GmbH.

Bij ons vind je korte lijnen, een nuchtere werksfeer en collega’s die zeggen wat ze doen en doen wat ze zeggen.

Ben jij thuis op een 16-tons graafmachine?

Voor onze funderingsprojecten zoeken wij een ervaren graafmachinist voor een circa 16-tons rupsgraafmachine.

Je werkt direct samen met de boormachinist, funderingswerkers en uitvoerder en zorgt ervoor dat de bouwplaats rondom de funderingswerkzaamheden goed voorbereid, veilig en efficiënt blijft.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met grondverzet, het voorbereiden en onderhouden van de werkplek, het verplaatsen van materiaal en het ondersteunen van de funderingsploeg.

Je weet wat een machine kan, werkt gecontroleerd en houdt voortdurend rekening met collega’s, andere machines en werkzaamheden in jouw omgeving.

Jouw werkzaamheden

- Veilig en zelfstandig bedienen van een circa 16-tons rupsgraafmachine;
- Uitvoeren van grondverzet op funderingsprojecten;
- Egaliseren en voorbereiden van werkterreinen;
- Vrijmaken en toegankelijk houden van de werkplek rondom de funderingsmachine;
- Verplaatsen van grond en bouwmaterialen;
- Ondersteunen van de funderingsploeg tijdens de uitvoering;
- Voorbereiden van locaties voor het aanbrengen van funderingspalen;
- Werken volgens tekeningen, maatvoering en aanwijzingen van de uitvoerder;
- Veilig werken rondom funderingsmachines, vrachtwagens en ander zwaar materieel;
- Uitvoeren van de dagelijkse machinecontrole en LMRA;
- Controleren van hydrauliek, rupsen, bakken, snelwissel en andere aanbouwdelen;
- Signaleren van slijtage, schade en storingen;
- Uitvoeren van dagelijks onderhoud en kleine werkzaamheden aan de machine;
- Zorgdragen voor een veilige, nette en goed georganiseerde werkplek.

Waar jij blij van wordt

- Een passend salaris (cao Bouw & Infra), afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;
- Een contract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband;
- 45 vrije dagen per jaar;
- Uitbetaling van overuren of compensatie in vrije tijd;
- Vergoeding van reisuren en toepasselijke toeslagen volgens de geldende bedrijfsregeling;
- Een moderne graafmachine en goed onderhouden materieel;
- Veel zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid;
- Afwisselende funderingsprojecten door heel Nederland;
- Een klein en betrokken team;
- Korte communicatielijnen;
- Een collegiale en nuchtere werksfeer;
- Cursussen, opleidingen en doorgroeimogelijkheden;
- Mogelijkheid om benodigde certificaten via AA Schroefpalen te behalen;
- Werkkleding, veiligheidsschoenen en persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen van de zaak.

Waar wij blij van worden

- Ervaring als graafmachinist, bij voorkeur op rupsgraafmachines in de klasse van circa 14–18 ton;
- Ervaring in de bouw, infra, grondverzet of funderingstechniek is een pré;
- Je hebt gevoel voor machines en werkt nauwkeurig;
- Technisch inzicht en basiskennis van mechaniek en hydrauliek;
- Een geldig VCA-certificaat en TCVT certificaat of de bereidheid om dit via ons te behalen;
- Rijbewijs B; rijbewijs BE, C of CE is een pré;
- Je kunt tekeningen, maatvoering en werkinstructies begrijpen;
- Je werkt veilig en houdt rekening met mensen en materieel om je heen;
- Je bent zelfstandig, verantwoordelijk en praktisch ingesteld;
- Je kunt goed samenwerken met boormachinisten, funderingswerkers en uitvoerders;
- Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal voldoende om veilig te kunnen werken en instructies te begrijpen;
- Je bent flexibel inzetbaar op projecten door heel Nederland;
- Incidenteel overnachten voor een project is voor jou bespreekbaar.

Vakmanschap, verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel en motivatie zijn voor ons belangrijker dan een perfect passend cv.

title: CNC Fräser/in(m/w/d) (Zerspanungsmechaniker/in)
description:
Sind Sie bereit für größere Aufgaben?

Als CNC-Fräser(m/w/d) arbeiten Sie bei diesem Unternehmen in der Region Venlo im Bereich der Großbearbeitung.

Erfahrung ist ein Muss!

Sie machen sich gerne an die Arbeit und fühlen sich in einer informellen, familiären Arbeitsatmosphäre wohl.

Ihr zukünftiger Arbeitsplatz ist eine große Bearbeitungsabteilung, in der unter anderem Maschinenteile aus Gusseisen und Aluminium bearbeitet werden. Diese Teile zeichnen sich durch eine große Vielfalt von Abmessungen aus. Sie reichen von Einzelstücken bis zu kleinen Serien.

Auf modernen CNC-Maschinen (3 und 5 Achsen) stellen Sie komplexe und präzise Produkte mit großen Abmessungen her.
Sie erhalten Zeichnungen mit mehreren Ansichten und Querschnitten, einschließlich Vorrichtungszeichnungen, Daten zur Arbeitsvorbereitung und die CNC-Programme.
Außerdem bereiten Sie Ihre Arbeit vor: Sie wählen die Materialien und Werkzeuge aus, richten die Maschine ein und optimieren die Programme an der Werkbank.

Stellenanforderungen

- Sie haben einen technischen Hintergrund z.B. Mittlere Führungskräfteausbildung oder Fachausbildung, z. B. Zerspanungstechnik und haben umfassende Kenntnisse im Lesen von Zeichnungen.
- Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung als CNC-Fräser.
- Kenntnisse über verschiedene Metalllegierungen, Form- und Lagetoleranzen.
- Sie haben bereits (regelmäßig bis häufig) 3- bis 5-Achs-Fräsmaschinen optimiert und vielleicht auch programmiert.
- Kenntnisse und Erfahrung im Umgang mit verschiedenen Messinstrumenten.
- Wenn Sie bereits mit Siemens-, Fanuc- oder Heidenhain-Steuerung gearbeitet haben, haben Sie einen Vorteil.

Arbeitsbedingungen

- Bruttomonatsgehalt bis 3.800 €.
- Reisekostenerstattung.
- 25 Feiertage und 13 ATV-Tage.
- Urlaubsgeld (8%)

Highlights

Arbeitswoche 36 - 40 Stunden in Tagdienst
Arbeitsvertrag befristeter Vertrag(12 Mon.)
Standort Venlo (Niederlande)
Gehalt Bruttomonatsgehalt max. € 3.800,-
Fahrgeld (0,23 cent netto pro Kilometer)
Urlaubsgeld 8%
38 Ferientage

Unternehmensprofil

In dieser kompakten, aber modernen Maschinenfabrik arbeiten eingefleischte Handwerker, oft schon seit vielen Jahren. Das Unternehmen hat einen treuen Kundenstamm für eine Vielzahl von Aufträgen: Bearbeitung (z. B. Fräsen, Drehen oder Drahterodieren) von Materialien und Überholung von Teilen. Vielfalt ist hier gewiss: Das Unternehmen hat sich auf Kleinserien und Einzelstücke in gleichbleibend hoher Qualität spezialisiert.

Unternehmenskultur

Die Atmosphäre in diesem Unternehmen ist informell: kurze Wege und gute Kontakte zwischen den Kollegen. Erwarten Sie hier keinen Schnickschnack: Das Credo ist, zur Sache zu kommen.

Weitergehende Informationen zum Thema „Arbeiten in den Niederlanden“ finden Sie unter www.grenzarbeit.eu/venlo

title: Strategischer Einkäufer (m/w/d) eCommerce | Healthcare & Pharmazie - ROSSMANN-Apotheke B.V. (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
description:
Mit der Rossmann-Apotheke B.V. bauen wir ein neues Angebot im digitalen Gesundheitsmarkt auf: Eine vollwertige Apotheke, die einen einfachen, verantwortungsvollen und kundenorientierten Zugang zu Arzneimitteln und apothekennaher Gesundheitsversorgung ermöglichen wird. Dabei verbinden wir die Sicherheit eines krisenfesten Unternehmens mit der Dynamik eines modernen E-Commerce- und Logistikumfelds.

In der Rolle unterstützen Sie den Aufbau der ROSSMANN-Apotheke von Anfang an mit. Statt bestehende Strukturen zu verwalten, entwickeln Sie als Dienstleister für die Apotheke neue Lieferantenpartnerschaften, Sortimentsstrategien und Wachstumsfelder für ein Geschäftsfeld mit hoher strategischer Bedeutung.

Das bewirken Sie bei uns

Als Strategischer Einkäufer (m/w/d) eCommerce | Healthcare & Pharmazie übernehmen Sie die strategische Verantwortung für ausgewählte Sortimentsbereiche der ROSSMANN-Apotheke. Sie entwickeln Lieferantenpartnerschaften, Preis- und Sortimentsstrategien und leisten einen wesentlichen Beitrag zum Wachstum eines zukunftsorientierten Geschäftsfeldes. Dabei agieren Sie an der Schnittstelle zwischen Markt, Herstellern und internen Fachbereichen.

- Sortimentsstrategie:  Sie bauen unsere pharmazeutischen Sortimente im eCommerce kontinuierlich auf und identifizieren neue Umsatz-, Markt- und Wachstumspotenziale zur Etablierung auf dem Markt
- Lieferantenentwicklung:  Sie bauen strategische Partnerschaften auf, entwickeln erste Kooperationen weiter und gestalten die zukünftige Lieferantenstruktur aktiv mit
- Verhandlungen:  Sie führen Jahresgespräche sowie Preis-, Konditions- und Vertragsverhandlungen und erzielen nachhaltige Ergebnisse für unser Geschäft
- Preisstrategie:  Sie analysieren Markt-, Sortiments- und Wettbewerbsentwicklungen und leiten daraus fundierte Preis- und Handlungsempfehlungen ab
- Geschäftsentwicklung:  Sie begleiten den Ausbau der ROSSMANN-Apotheke und wirken aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung strategischer Beschaffungs- und Vermarktungskonzepte mit, dabei bringen Sie ihre Ideen proaktiv ein
- Schnittstellenmanagement:  Gemeinsam mit internen Stakeholdern aus dem Marketing und dem Management der Apotheke entwickeln Sie erfolgreiche Wachstumsinitiativen für das eCommerce-Geschäft der ROSSMANN-Apotheke. Durch Ihre Persönlichkeit schaffen Sie es sich ein Netzwerk in der Pharmabranche aufzubauen
- Innovation:  Sie treiben Zukunftsthemen wie den Ausbau von Direktbezugsmodellen und die Entwicklung neuer Lieferantenstrategien im Apothekenumfeld voran

Das bringen Sie mit

- Qualifikation:  Ihre Basis ist ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaft, Gesundheitsökonomie, Pharmazie oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Berufserfahrung:  Sie bringen mehrjährige Erfahrung im strategischen Einkauf, Category Management oder im Lieferantenmanagement mit und haben bereits Verantwortung für Sortimente, Umsatz- oder Geschäftsentwicklung übernommen
- Branchenverständnis:   Idealerweise verfügen Sie über Erfahrungen im Pharma-, Healthcare-, Apotheken-, Handels- oder FMCG-Umfeld
- Verhandlungsgeschick:  Sie überzeugen durch eine hohe Abschlussstärke und haben Erfahrung in der Führung anspruchsvoller Lieferanten- und Vertragsverhandlungen
- Analysekompetenz:   Auf Basis von Kennzahlen, Marktanalysen und wirtschaftlichen Rahmenbedingungen treffen Sie Entscheidungen
- Unternehmerisches Denken und Innovationsgeist:   Sie verfügen über die Fähigkeit, Chancen in dynamischen Märkten zu identifizieren, innovative Konzepte zu entwickeln und diese erfolgreich in nachhaltige Geschäftserfolge zu überführen
- Reisebereitschaft:  Den persönlichen Austausch mit Geschäftspartnern schätzen Sie und bringen die Bereitschaft für Dienstreisen mit

Das gibt's bei uns obendrauf

- 30 Tage Urlaub
- Weihnachts- und Urlaubsgeld

- Personalrabatt & Einkaufsgutscheine

title: Vikariat 40%
description:
Åpnet annonsen på Finn.no? For den beste leseropplevelsen anbefaler vi at du åpner annonsen i vårt rekrutteringssystem Teamtailor, ved å trykke "Søk her" til høyre for, eller i bunnen av Finn-annonsen.

Elsker du å jobbe tett med andre, og motiveres du av å skape resultater i team? I Big Bite er vi like opptatt av menneskene på begge sidene av disken, og vi definerer oss selv som Superhelter for sultne folk i farta!

Er du vår nye superhelt på Big Bite Futura? Vi ser etter en vikariat i 40% stilling ut Desember, med mulighet for fast ansettelse ved behov.

Ikke alle helter har kappe. Noen har caps med logo på. Og nå jakter vi den rette medarbeider som kan jobbe både dag, kveld og helg. Du skal ikke bare temme sult og slukke tørst, men også spre hverdagsglede. 💥 

Med Big Bite får du sjanse til å være med på en lærerik reise i et helnorsk fastfood-konsept som tilbyr rask og rimelig mat i farta, med nysmurte subs som hovedprodukt. 🌯

Veteran eller ungt heltetalent?
Rett mentale innstilling veier vel så tungt som en CV med erfaring. Du vil fort se at Big Bite-systemet ikke holder kunnskapen innelåst. Tvert om, vi deler. Her bygger veteraner opp ferskinger. 

I tillegg kan du skilte med andre superkrefter, som at du:

  • Er serviceinnstilt og fremoverlent

  • Trives med et høyt arbeidstempo

  • Har et øye for salg

Våre verdier oppsummeres i ordet ELSK og står sterkt hos oss. Vi ser derfor etter kandidater som gjenspeiler disse:

  • EIERSKAP - Vi er stolte ambassadører som tar ansvar for hele virksomheten - økonomisk og sosialt. Aldri halvveis, aldri litt.

  • LIDENSKAP - Vi brenner for jobben vår, trives i et sultent prestasjonsmiljø og har et varmt hjerte for mat og mennesker.

  • SAMSPILL - Vi spiller hverandre gode, unner andre suksess og vet at vi alltid presterer sterkest sammen.

  • KREMMERÅND - Vi er offensive og griper muligheter for utvikling og vekst. Vi vet at gode resultater kommer av å skape og gjenskape fine gjesteopplevelser - bedre for hver dag.

Hvorfor skal du velge oss?
Vi tilbyr grundig opplæring og en sosial og trivelig arbeidsplass med hyggelige kolleger. I fellesskap jobber vi for gode kundeopplevelser, likeså viktig er det at vi tar vare på hverandre i Big Bite-familien. 🥳 

Blir du trigget av dette håper vi å høre fra deg! 

Sjekk ut vår karriereside og alle våre ledige stillinger ved å trykke her - da vil du få et enda større innblikk i hvordan det er å jobbe i Big Bite. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Big Bite åpnet sin første avdeling i Trondheim i 1997 med en ambisjon om å lage rask og smakfull mat til folk i farta. I dag finnes Big Bite i hjertet av over 70 kjøpesenter og handlegater over hele Norge. Vi er en sterk nasjonal merkevare i vekst. Idéen er enkel, men supergod. Subs laget av ferske baguetter fra lokal baker, friske salater og lune wraps - servert innen sekunder med et smil på kjøpet.
