GxP Compliance Expert
=====================




  








 **GxP Compliance Expert \- GxP / Compliance / Clinical Distribution Team / Managing deviations/CAPAs/improvements / GxP training / Root Cause Analysis (RCA / Englisch**



  **Background:**



A healthier future. It's what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That's what makes us Roche.



The Clinical Distribution organisation's objective is to cost\-effectively ensure the right product is in the right place at the right time every time, such that no patient will go without treatment and no clinical trial will be delayed.



The GxP Compliance Expert is a member of the Network \& Capabilities Chapter within the Clinical Distribution Team (Deliver), which is jointly accountable for all elements of clinical supply chain distribution for the global Roche/Genentech portfolio of \>500 studies. This role drives GxP compliance and quality within Clinical Distribution (Deliver). Key duties include proactive GxP advice, managing deviations/CAPAs/improvements, acting as the audit/inspection SME, handling regulated documents, analysing quality trends, and developing the team's GxP training.



  



  **The Perfect Candidate:**



For this position, we are seeking an experienced professional with a relevant university degree and several years of solid working experience in GxP compliance and the clinical supply chain. The ideal candidate brings proven expertise in regulatory requirements and quality standards, along with experience in audit and inspection processes. Structured and customer\-oriented working methods, strong communication skills, and fluency in both German and English are required



  



 **Tasks \& Responsibilities:**



* SME for all GxP and compliance\-related topics (proactive advice on these matters) incl system administration (Veeva quality docs)
* Audit/Inspection SME for Deliver for non\-study specific examinations
* Processing of deviations as well as CAPAs, Changes, Process Improvements
* Quality KPI Ownership for Deliver
* Responsibility for deviation management improvement processes
* Offer comprehensive compliance expertise to the business, conducting Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to identify and address quality, regulatory and compliance\-related issues
* Managing the structure for the departments' SOPs and any other regulated documents (The business know\-how is provided by the chapter's SMEs)
* Responsibility for trend reporting across Quality and Compliance requirements
* Implementation of GxP training and further development of employees' GxP knowledge


  



 **Must Haves:**



* You hold a degree (BA, MS, MBA) in a relevant field (e.g. Supply Chain Management \& Logistics, Pharmacy, Biology, Chemistry, Industrial Engineering and Management), backed by significant expertise and extensive years of senior professional experience.
* At least 6 years of professional experience
* You possess extensive knowledge of cGMP standards alongside hands\-on experience navigating internal (PTQ, Pharma\-Technical Quality) and external (e.g., FDA, EMA) regulatory inspections.
* You bring a deep understanding of end\-to\-end supply chain management, specifically encompassing warehouse and transportation management, logistics, and clinical supply chain distribution processes.
* You demonstrate strong interpersonal, communication, organisational, and prioritisation skills with a steadfast focus on customer needs.
* You are fluent in both written and spoken German and English.
* You are proficient in using Google applications, MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Visio, and key industry systems such as Veeva and Cornerstone**.**

Senior Specialist, IT  
Place of work: Basel, Switzerland  
Employment rate: 50–100%  
Start date: 1 January 2027 or sooner  
Contract type: Permanent  
Other: Must be eligible to work in Switzerland  
Basel Institute on Governance  
The Basel Institute on Governance is a hands\-on centre of competence dedicated to promoting good governance and countering corruption for a more peaceful, just and sustainable world. Established in 2003 in Basel, Switzerland, the Institute works with partners worldwide to advance knowledge, practice and policy on anti\-corruption, asset recovery and business integrity. With field operations worldwide, it has some 150 staff covering 32 nationalities. The Basel Institute is an Associated Institute of the University of Basel.  
Job description  
The Senior Specialist, IT takes operational ownership of the Basel Institute’s IT infrastructure, security and identity management. Working closely with and deputising for the Head, IT and eLearning, the successful candidate will keep the Basel Institute’s systems secure, available and well\-documented, lead the day\-to\-day implementation of the IT Security and Operations Policy and help with the safe and effective adoption of new technologies, including AI. The Senior Specialist will also supervise and develop the Associate, IT.  
Key responsibilities  
Implement, maintain and monitor the Basel Institute’s IT Security and Operations Policy and support the disaster recovery and malware response plans.  
Maintain and monitor the IT infrastructure, including the Sophos firewall appliance, UniFi wireless network, Xerox printers, 3CX phone system, Synology NAS devices and the NextCloud shared drive.  
Manage users, authentication and access rights across Active Directory and Google Workspace, including onboarding and offboarding and regular access reviews.  
Provide and coordinate cybersecurity awareness training for staff, including onboarding and regular refresher training and act as a point of contact for reporting and responding to security incidents.  
Identify, evaluate and implement AI tools and solutions to improve IT operations and support their safe, compliant and well\-governed adoption across the Basel Institute.  
Supervise, mentor and develop the Associate, IT, coordinating day\-to\-day support and workload.  
Oversee IT asset management, backups and system monitoring, coordinate with external service providers and deputise for the Head, IT and eLearning as required.  
Provide first\-level IT support to staff alongside the Associate, IT, ensuring timely resolution and acting as the escalation point for more complex issues.  
Qualifications and skills  
University degree or equivalent vocational qualification in information technology, computer science or a related field.  
At least five years of experience in IT systems administration and infrastructure, ideally in a mixed on\-premises and cloud environment.  
Proven expertise in network and firewall administration (Sophos experience is an advantage), identity and access management (Active Directory, Google Workspace) as well as IT security.  
Relevant experience with UniFi Wi\-Fi, Synology NAS, NextCloud, 3CX telephony and remote management/monitoring tools, as well as experience supervising or mentoring colleagues, is an advantage.  
Proficient in Microsoft and Google Workspace administration.  
Experience in a major AI platform (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) and the creation and management of skills, plugins, connectors, agents and MCP servers.  
Languages: Excellent English skills; a good command of German and proficiency in other languages are an advantage.  
Offer  
We offer an interesting and rewarding working environment with a proactive, dynamic and international team spirit. The work is both routine and varied, and offers scope for initiative and innovation. The salary is competitive.

description:
Health Safety Environment Manager / Deputy Health and Safety Manager  


  











Health Safety Environment Manager / Deputy Health and Safety Manager
====================================================================




  








 **Department:** **HSE Management**



 **Reports to:** **Project Manager / Deputy Project Manager**



 **Responsible for:** **providing professional and technical HSE expertise, direction and guidance to the project**



 **Location:** **Construction site office in Beringen**



 **Start Date:**  



 **Employment: Type** **Full time / On\-Site**



ENKA Investment AG is seeking an HSE Manager for its planned data center project in Beringen, Schaffhausen. You will lead site health, safety, and environmental management across construction and commissioning, working closely with local project leadership, subcontractors and ENKA’s headquarters HSE team in Istanbul.



  ***Required Knowledge and Qualifications***



* A degree or recognized professional diploma in occupational health and safety, engineering or a related field.
* At least 10 years of construction HSE experience, including at least 3 years in a leadership role managing HSE personnel and coordinating multiple subcontractors on a major project.
* Experience in energization or commissioning while construction activities were still in progress. A clear understanding of the transition from construction to live systems is essential.
* A working understanding of Civil, Structural and Architectural (CSA) and Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) construction risks, risk assessment, work permits and hazardous energy controls.
* Proven ability to lead investigations, challenge unsafe practices constructively and secure corrective action from project teams and subcontractors under programme pressure
* Professional working proficiency in English and Turkish, spoken and written. (German is a plus for local site coordination), English the international project team, and Turkish daily meetings and reporting with Istanbul headquarters.
* Strong reporting and document management skills, with experience using digital HSE systems and practical performance measures. A site\-based approach and the ability to coach a multicultural workforce are essential.


  ***Main Duties and Responsibilities***



* Lead the project Health, Safety and Environment programme from site mobilization and civil works through mechanical, electrical and plumbing (MEP) installation, energization, commissioning and handover, working with project leadership and ENKA’s headquarters HSE team.
* Develop and maintain the site HSE plan, responsibilities, risk registers and assurance arrangements in line with Swiss requirements, project procedures and applicable client obligations.
* Work with the Design Manager and construction leads to review design and sequencing risks, temporary works interfaces and safe access for installation and maintenance.
* Coordinate subcontractor HSE plans, competence checks, inductions and method statements. Verify that each party controls its own activities and that interfaces between trades are addressed before work starts.
* Monitor high risk construction activities, including excavations, temporary works, lifting operations, work at height, floor openings, steel and façade erection, hot works and confined space entry where applicable.
* Work with electrical and commissioning leads on permit to work, hazardous energy control, lockout/tagout, access restrictions and the separation of live systems from ongoing construction.
* Check that safety arrangements cover heavy plant installation, generators, UPS and battery systems, cooling equipment, pressure testing and associated fuel or hazardous substances, as applicable to the design.
* Maintain a strong site presence through inspections, audits and workforce engagement. Stop unsafe work, escalate significant risks and verify effective corrective action before authorized work resumption.
* Lead incident and near miss investigations, identify underlying causes and track corrective actions to closure. Maintain reliable records and report trends that support prevention and open reporting.
* Coordinate occupational health controls, welfare arrangements and environmental measures, including dust, noise, heat, waste, site water, spill prevention and relevant permit conditions.
* Develop emergency arrangements with site teams and relevant local services; organise drills and confirm that plans remain suitable as construction and commissioning conditions change.
* Coach HSE personnel and subcontractor supervisors, deliver practical briefings and ensure that safety instructions are understood across a multilingual workforce.
* Attend daily coordination meetings with ENKA’s Istanbul headquarters HSE team in Turkish and provide daily risk and action updates, together with regular project performance reports.

Family Office Adminstrator
==========================

**Family Office Administrator**

**Reports to:** Managing Director

**About Linden Management AG**

Linden Management is a boutique family office providing strategic, administrative, investment, and operational support across multiple entities and stakeholders.

Our environment is professional, collaborative, and relationship\-driven, with a strong emphasis on discretion, service excellence, accountability, and operational efficiency. We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional support while maintaining the highest standards of integrity, confidentiality, and professionalism.

We are seeking a motivated Family Office Administrator to support day\-to\-day office operations and provide administrative assistance to the Managing Director and the principals of the family office.

**Position Summary**

The Family Office Administrator provides office administration and administrative support to the Managing Director and the principals, helping ensure the smooth day\-to\-day running of the family office.

The role supports office administration, executive support activities, and concierge services for the principals and their families. Working with trusted partners and service providers, the Family Office Administrator helps ensure family office activities are handled efficiently, professionally, and discreetly.

The successful candidate is highly organized, service\-oriented, and detail\-focused, with a strong commitment to accuracy and quality. They are able to respond with an appropriate sense of urgency while taking the necessary care to ensure work is complete, accurate, and professionally presented before it is finalized or distributed.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Support to the Managing Director**

Provide day\-to\-day administrative support to the Managing Director. Coordinate meetings, including agendas, meeting materials, presentations, and follow\-up actions. Liaise with trusted partners, banks, trustees, lawyers, tax advisors, and service providers to facilitate requests as directed by the Managing correspondence, reports, presentations, and other business documentation. Track action items and support the timely completion of administrative priorities.

**Support to Principals \& Family**

Provide concierge services to the principals and their families. Coordinate travel arrangements, accommodations, reservations, transportation, and other lifestyle\-related requests. Support family events, charitable initiatives, and special projects. Maintain accurate and confidential family office records.

**Office Administration**

Support the day\-to\-day administrative operation of the family office. Supporting the "Accounting \& Investment Teams" Data EntryManage office supplies, equipment, vendors, couriers, and facilities\-related organized electronic and physical filing systems. Prepare, proofread, and distribute administrative documentation. Support meeting agendas, minutes, and recurring administrative reporting. Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes and office efficiency.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

3–5 years' experience within a family office, wealth management, financial services, private office, or professional services environment is supporting senior executives, high\-net\-worth individuals, or private clients is an asset. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a professional industry experience an asset

**Skills \& Competencies**

Strong organizational and time management skills. Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and to work with a sense of urgency while maintaining high standards of accuracy. Strong written and verbal communication skills in German and English. Professional, service\-oriented, and discreet approach. Strong interpersonal skills. Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and changing demands. Strong proofreading and quality\-control in Microsoft Office Suite and standard business applications.

**Success Measures**

Success in this role will be demonstrated through:

Consistently accurate, complete, and high\-quality work. Timely and reliable execution with an appropriate sense of urgency, without compromising accuracy or attention to detail. Professional, responsive, and discreet support to the Managing Director, principals, and their families. Efficient and well\-organized administration of the family office.

**Why Join Linden Management AG?**

Joining Linden Management offers the opportunity to build a career within a high\-trust, collaborative family office environment where professionalism, integrity, and service excellence are valued. This role provides broad exposure to office administration, executive support, and family office operations, making it an excellent starting point for an early\-career professional seeking to develop within a boutique family office.

title: School Shop Support Assistant
description:
JOB PURPOSE
The School Support Assistant provides reliable, flexible support to the School Shop and other areas of the School throughout a 12-month fixed-term contract. The role includes planned work during the twice-yearly stock takes in January and July and during the annual Essentials Fair. At other times, the post holder may be offered work when additional support is needed, including staff sickness cover, alumni reunions, special occasions, busy periods and other operational requirements.
Post holders are expected to act as ambassadors for Aiglon, provide a helpful and professional service, and adapt confidently to different duties, teams and working environments.
CONTRACT AND AVAILABILITY
Fixed-term contract of 12 months.
Planned attendance for the January stock take, July stock take and annual Essentials Fair, on dates communicated in advance.
For the remainder of the year, additional assignments may be offered as operational needs arise and will be agreed according to the School’s requirements and the post holder’s availability.
Hours may vary depending on the assignment and may include early mornings, evenings or weekends for special events.
GENERAL REQUIREMENTS
An ideal candidate will:
Be reliable, punctual, flexible and available for the planned work periods.
Respond promptly and professionally when contacted about additional work.
Have effective communication skills and good interpersonal skills.
Work well as part of a team and independently after instruction.
Be confident, approachable and reassuring when supporting students, families, visitors and colleagues.
Be methodical, organised and attentive to detail.
Be comfortable working with numbers and have basic IT skills.
Exercise discretion and respect confidentiality.
Be willing and able to undertake physical work, including lifting boxes and standing for extended periods.
KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Twice-yearly stock takes - January and July
Count merchandise accurately and follow stock-take procedures as instructed.
Record and input quantities clearly and correctly, and double-check discrepancies when required.
Reorganise shelves and storage areas and ensure products are correctly labelled and sized.
Identify damaged, missing or obsolete items and report inconsistencies promptly.
Support restocking, merchandising and preparation of the shop for reopening.
Essentials Fair
Help set up the Fair, including moving boxes and furniture, counting and labelling stock, checking barcodes and preparing displays.
Distribute stationery orders and deliver goods to buildings or boarding houses as required.
Welcome and advise students and parents on uniforms, expedition kit and other purchases.
Use the checkout system to invoice purchases and label clothing with name tapes.
Pack away remaining stock and restock the School Shop after the Fair.
On-call and Additional Support
Provide temporary cover when a member of staff is absent or when another short-term need arises.
Support alumni reunions, school events, special occasions and other periods of increased activity.
Assist with customer service, reception, sales, stock handling, setup, pack-down, deliveries, administration or other suitable duties according to the assignment.
Follow the instructions of the manager responsible for each assignment and work cooperatively with the team.
Undertake any other reasonable tasks consistent with the purpose of the role and the post holder’s skills and training.
Working Conditions
Work may take place in the School Shop, storage areas, event spaces or other locations across the campus.
The role can involve lifting and moving boxes or furniture, standing for extended periods and working in busy, fast-paced environments.
Appropriate induction, instructions and task-specific training will be provided.
OTHER TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Undertake any other tasks which may be reasonably required by the School Shop Manager to assist in the smooth running of the School Shop
Understand and implement all school policies and procedures, particularly those relating to safeguarding children and young people
Understand the School’s Guiding Principles and uphold the ethos of the School at all times
